strings.issue:NMB-137:desc:0: SSO login fails when the IdP assertion NameID email has a mixed-case domain (e.g. User@Example.COM) while the Nimbus user record stores the domain lowercased (user@example.com). Local-part case handling is already fine; only the domain comparison breaks.
strings.issue:NMB-137:desc:1: Authentication should succeed when the case-insensitive email matches a provisioned user. Today the SSO callback does an exact string match on the full NameID against users.email, returning No user matched this identity for mixed-case domains.
strings.issue:NMB-137:desc:2: Enterprise IdPs often emit domains in the case registered in their directory. Normalizing both sides with a domain-lowercase (RFC 5321) compare before lookup should allow login without forcing customers to re-provision.
strings.issue:NMB-138:title: Editor slash command menu stays open after switching to another browser tab
strings.issue:NMB-138:desc:0: Invoking a slash command in the editor opens the command menu. If the user switches to another browser tab while the menu is open, then returns, the menu is still open and positioned at stale coordinates, often floating over unrelated content until Escape is pressed.
strings.issue:NMB-138:desc:1: Leaving the document (blur of the window or editor) should close the slash menu like other editor popovers. The slash plugin listens for focusout on the editor root but ignores document.visibilitychange and window blur, so tab switches never dismiss it.
strings.issue:NMB-138:desc:2: Stale menus capture the next keystrokes when the user returns, inserting a command they no longer want. Closing on visibilitychange hidden and on editor blur aligns with mention and emoji pickers.
strings.issue:NMB-139:title: Notification digests duplicate events that occurred near the midnight boundary
strings.issue:NMB-139:desc:0: Daily digest emails assembled after 00:00 UTC sometimes list the same card activity twice when the underlying event timestamp sits within a few minutes of the day boundary. A workspace that ran a digest at 00:07 UTC saw three assignment changes from 23:58–00:02 appear once under “Yesterday” and again under “Today”.
strings.issue:NMB-139:desc:1: Expected behavior is that each event_id contributes to exactly one digest window. The window should close on the exclusive upper bound of the previous calendar day in the workspace timezone, not on the worker’s clock alone.
strings.issue:NMB-139:desc:2: What we observe is double inclusion whenever the digest job’s dayKey is derived from UTC while event buckets are still keyed with America/Los_Angeles offsets. The likely root cause is that DigestAggregator.hashBucket(workspaceId, dayKey) reuses the UTC day string even after the timezone shift was applied to the query filter, so events near midnight land in two buckets before dedupe runs.
strings.issue:NMB-139:desc:3: Recipients on plans with digests enabled get noisy mail and start marking Nimbus as spam. Support has three open threads from last week referencing this pattern.
strings.issue:NMB-14:title: keyboard shortcuts throws 500 when the workspace has no members
strings.issue:NMB-14:desc:0: Steps to reproduce: open keyboard shortcuts with a workspace that has more than one member.
strings.issue:NMB-14:desc:1: Expected: the view keeps the selected filters after a reload.
strings.issue:NMB-14:desc:2: Actual: filters reset to the default and the row count changes.
strings.issue:NMB-14:desc:3: Impact: reported by two customers this week; no data loss observed.
strings.issue:NMB-140:title: Card labels overflow the chip row without a +N overflow indicator
strings.issue:NMB-140:desc:0: On dense cards that carry more than four labels, the chip row clips the trailing chips against the card edge. There is no “+N” affordance, so reviewers cannot tell how many labels are hidden without opening the card.
strings.issue:NMB-140:desc:1: Design expects the row to keep visible chips up to the available width, then collapse the remainder into a single overflow chip that shows the count and a tooltip of names. Opening the card should still list every label.
strings.issue:NMB-140:desc:2: In practice the flex container never measures residual width before paint. Overflow is pure CSS clipping on .label-chip-row, so the count badge never mounts. Hypothesis: LabelChipRow reads maxVisible from a hardcoded 4 instead of computing fit from the card’s content box after the assignee avatar and due-date pill claim space.
strings.issue:NMB-140:desc:3: Boards with heavy labeling conventions look broken; customers assume labels were deleted.
strings.issue:NMB-141:title: Billing receipt email links open the app root instead of the invoice detail
strings.issue:NMB-141:desc:0: Receipt emails sent after a successful charge include a “View invoice” button and a plain-text URL. Both currently resolve to https://app.example.com/ rather than the invoice detail page for that charge.
strings.issue:NMB-141:desc:1: Users should land on /billing/invoices/{invoiceId} already authenticated (or prompted to sign in with a return URL). The deep link must survive email client link wrappers.
strings.issue:NMB-141:desc:2: Actual clicks always hit the app shell home route. The template interpolates {{invoice_url}} from BillingMailer, which was still building paths with only the origin after the billing SPA route rename. Suspect the receipt partial still reads legacy path /account/receipts and the gateway 302s unknown billing paths to /.
strings.issue:NMB-141:desc:3: Finance contacts cannot jump from mail to the PDF-ready page; ticket volume spiked after the March billing UI redesign.
strings.issue:NMB-142:title: Dashboard widget drag-and-drop reorders silently fail for the last row
strings.issue:NMB-142:desc:0: Rearranging dashboard widgets works for every row except the bottom-most one. Dragging a widget that currently occupies the last grid row shows the ghost preview, then snaps back to the original index on drop with no toast.
strings.issue:NMB-142:desc:1: Reorder should persist through PATCH /api/v2/dashboards/{id}/layout and reload with the new order. Failure ought to surface an error if the write is rejected.
strings.issue:NMB-142:desc:2: Silent no-ops happen only when sourceIndex === layout.length - 1. The client still fires the request, but the payload’s targetIndex is clamped with target capped at length - 2, so the last slot can never receive a move-in. That clamp looks like a leftover guard from when the “add widget” tile occupied a permanent trailing cell.
strings.issue:NMB-142:desc:3: Power users who keep timeline widgets at the bottom cannot prioritize them without deleting and re-adding the widget.
strings.issue:NMB-143:title: Password reset token is accepted twice if both tabs submit within 1 second
strings.issue:NMB-143:desc:0: A password-reset link can be consumed twice if two browser tabs both POST the new password within about one second of each other. Both responses return 200 and establish sessions.
strings.issue:NMB-143:desc:1: Tokens must be single-use: the first successful redemption should invalidate the token atomically so a concurrent attempt receives 410 Gone with “link already used”.
strings.issue:NMB-143:desc:2: Race is reproducible with two tabs sharing the same token query param. Both hit POST /auth/reset-password before either transaction commits the used_at column. Leading theory is missing SELECT … FOR UPDATE (or an equivalent single-flight Redis lock on token_hash) around the redeem path; the unique partial index on unused tokens is not enough under read-committed isolation.
strings.issue:NMB-143:desc:3: If a reset email leaks, an attacker and the legitimate user can both set passwords; audit logs show two password_changed events for one token_id.
strings.issue:NMB-144:title: Editor markdown paste converts nested lists into a flat numbered list
strings.issue:NMB-144:desc:0: Pasting markdown that contains nested unordered or ordered lists into the document editor flattens every item into a single top-level numbered list. Nested structure and bullet markers are lost.
strings.issue:NMB-144:desc:1: Paste of a commonmark-style snippet with two levels of indentation should produce nested list nodes in the editor document tree, preserving ordered vs unordered type per level.
strings.issue:NMB-144:desc:2: Instead, the HTML clipboard path runs a list normalizer that walks li elements without reading data-indent or nested ul/ol wrappers from the clipboard HTML. Suspected cause: MarkdownPastePlugin converts nested lists to sequential paragraphs first, then ListInputRule renumbers only top-level blocks, discarding depth metadata from the AST.
strings.issue:NMB-144:desc:3: Writers who draft in external markdown tools spend extra time re-indenting after every paste.
strings.issue:NMB-145:title: Let users pin a saved view to the sidebar
strings.issue:NMB-145:desc:0: Saved views already live under the board filter menu, but frequent views still take two clicks to reopen. Several design partners asked to pin a view so it appears as a persistent entry under the project sidebar.
strings.issue:NMB-145:desc:1: Proposal: from the saved-view overflow menu, “Pin to sidebar” stores pin_order on the view record (max 8 pins per user per project). Sidebar shows the pin label; clicking applies the same filter/sort payload as opening the view from the menu. Unpin is available from both sidebar context menu and the view manager.
strings.issue:NMB-145:desc:2: Acceptance: pinned views survive reload, respect sharing (private pins stay private), and do not appear for users lacking view:read. Reordering pins via drag updates pin_order without changing the underlying query.
strings.issue:NMB-146:title: Allow bulk reassignment of cards from the board multi-select toolbar
strings.issue:NMB-146:desc:0: Reassigning many cards today means opening each card or using a brittle CSV round-trip. Ops teams running sprint cleanup need a multi-select path that does not leave the board.
strings.issue:NMB-146:desc:1: When two or more cards are selected, the multi-select toolbar gains “Reassign…”, opening a member picker. Confirm calls POST /boards/{id}/cards/bulk-reassign with card_ids and assignee_id (or null to unassign). Activity feed records one bulk event plus per-card assignee history.
strings.issue:NMB-146:desc:2: Done when selection of 50 cards reassigns within 3s on a median board, permissions mirror single-card assign rules, and partial failures return which card_ids were skipped.
strings.issue:NMB-147:title: Show estimated vs actual cycle time on the dashboard velocity chart
strings.issue:NMB-147:desc:0: The velocity chart currently plots completed points per sprint only. Planning leads also want estimated cycle time (from the sprint commitment snapshot) drawn against actual median cycle time for finished cards.
strings.issue:NMB-147:desc:1: Extend the dashboard velocity series with two optional lines: estimate_hours from the sprint planning freeze, and actual_cycle_hours computed as entered_done_at − first_in_progress_at. Toggle in widget settings defaults to on for new widgets, off for existing ones to avoid surprising layout shifts.
strings.issue:NMB-147:desc:2: Ship criteria: tooltips show both values for a sprint column, empty sprints omit the actual line, and the export CSV gains estimate_cycle_h and actual_cycle_h columns.
strings.issue:NMB-148:title: Add a read-only share link for dashboards without requiring a full seat
strings.issue:NMB-148:desc:0: Stakeholders often need to see a dashboard without burning a paid seat. Today the only options are full invites or static screenshots that rot immediately.
strings.issue:NMB-148:desc:1: Introduce a read-only share link: workspace admins generate a link token with optional expiry (7 / 30 / never) and optional password. GET /public/dashboards/{token} renders widgets without edit chrome, live data refresh every 60s, and no sidebar navigation into the rest of the app.
strings.issue:NMB-148:desc:2: Acceptance includes revoke, rotate, audit log entry on create/revoke, rate limit of 120 req/min per token, and blocked access when the parent dashboard is deleted.
strings.issue:NMB-149:title: Let editors insert collapsible callout blocks from the slash menu
strings.issue:NMB-149:desc:0: Writers repeatedly fake callouts with blockquotes and emoji. That breaks consistency and is invisible to our a11y tree as a distinct region.
strings.issue:NMB-149:desc:1: Add a slash-menu item “Callout” that inserts a collapsible callout block with variants info / warn / success, an optional title, and a chevron that toggles body visibility. Collapsed state is stored on the node attrs and syncs to collaborators.
strings.issue:NMB-149:desc:2: Ready when slash menu search matches “callout”, “note”, and “warning”; keyboard users can expand/collapse with Enter on the header; export to markdown uses a fenced callout convention we already parse on import.
strings.issue:NMB-15:title: dark mode contrast silently fails on first load
strings.issue:NMB-15:desc:0: Steps to reproduce: open dark mode contrast with a workspace that has more than one member.
strings.issue:NMB-15:desc:1: Expected: the view keeps the selected filters after a reload.
strings.issue:NMB-15:desc:2: Actual: filters reset to the default and the row count changes.
strings.issue:NMB-15:desc:3: Impact: reported by two customers this week; no data loss observed.
strings.issue:NMB-150:title: Surface upcoming invoice amount on the billing settings overview
strings.issue:NMB-150:desc:0: Billing settings show the current plan and payment method but not what the next invoice is expected to charge. Finance owners want that figure without downloading last month’s PDF.
strings.issue:NMB-150:desc:1: On the billing overview card, surface upcoming_invoice_amount and upcoming_invoice_date from the billing provider preview API, formatted in the workspace currency. Include a breakdown link to line items (seats, metered usage, credits).
strings.issue:NMB-150:desc:2: Complete when the amount updates within 15 minutes of seat changes, shows “Usage still metering” when the preview is partial, and hides the block for free-tier workspaces.
strings.issue:NMB-151:title: Support keyboard-only navigation through the notification inbox
strings.issue:NMB-151:desc:0: The notification inbox is largely mouse-driven: row focus is inconsistent, and several actions (mark read, archive, open target) are not reachable without a pointer.
strings.issue:NMB-151:desc:1: Support full keyboard use: arrow keys move roving tabindex across rows, Enter opens the deep link, e archives, r toggles read, and Escape returns focus to the inbox toggle. Screen readers should announce unread count changes via an aria-live region already used by the badge.
strings.issue:NMB-151:desc:2: Done when automated a11y scan clean on the inbox panel, documented shortcuts in the ? help popover, and a end-to-end path covers a 20-item inbox without mouse APIs.
strings.issue:NMB-152:title: Allow workspace admins to force SSO for all new member invitations
strings.issue:NMB-152:desc:0: Some regulated workspaces need every new member to authenticate via SSO from the first login. Today invites can still choose password signup if the admin only enabled SSO without enforcing it.
strings.issue:NMB-152:desc:1: Add a workspace auth setting force_sso_for_invites. When true, invitation emails send users through the IdP only; password and magic-link signup routes reject invite tokens for that workspace with a clear error. Existing password members are unaffected until a separate migration policy is chosen.
strings.issue:NMB-152:desc:2: Shipped criteria: default off, only owners can toggle, Directory-provisioned users already SSO-bound keep working, and audit log records enforcement changes.
strings.issue:NMB-153:title: Let users snooze a notification for 1 hour, tomorrow, or next week
strings.issue:NMB-153:desc:0: Users get interrupted by low-urgency notifications they want to see later, not dismiss forever. Archive is too permanent; leaving them unread keeps the badge noisy.
strings.issue:NMB-153:desc:1: On each notification row and the desktop toast, offer Snooze with presets: 1 hour, tomorrow 9:00 local, and next Monday 9:00 local. Snoozed items leave the inbox and reappear at the scheduled time as unread with a “Snoozed” provenance chip.
strings.issue:NMB-153:desc:2: Acceptance: cancel snooze from the scheduled list, respect quiet-hours if that ships later, and cap at 100 concurrent snoozes per user to protect the scheduler.
strings.issue:NMB-154:title: Add a compact density mode for the kanban board on laptop screens
strings.issue:NMB-154:desc:0: Kanban columns feel cramped on 13–14" laptop viewports once cards show cover images and three metadata rows. Horizontal scroll becomes the default interaction.
strings.issue:NMB-154:desc:1: Introduce a Compact density mode under board view options: reduces card padding, hides cover images, collapses description previews, and tightens column width to 260px. Preference is stored per user per board.
strings.issue:NMB-154:desc:2: Exit criteria: density toggle is keyboard reachable, print/export still uses comfortable density, and boards with 12+ columns fit a 1440px-wide window without horizontal scroll in compact mode for typical card content.
strings.issue:NMB-155:title: Show inline diffs when two collaborators edit the same paragraph
strings.issue:NMB-155:desc:0: When two people edit the same paragraph, the last writer often overwrites the other with only a coarse “conflict” toast. Users want to see both versions before choosing.
strings.issue:NMB-155:desc:1: If presence detects concurrent edits on the same block_id, show an inline diff gutter: remote insertions in one highlight, local in another, with Accept mine / Accept theirs / Merge line-by-line actions. Diffs are character-level for short paragraphs and line-level above 280 characters.
strings.issue:NMB-155:desc:2: Ready when conflicts no longer auto-apply remote wins, analytics track merge outcomes, and the flow works for at least two simultaneous peers on a single block.
strings.issue:NMB-156:title: Let billing admins download a usage CSV for any completed billing period
strings.issue:NMB-156:desc:0: Billing admins exporting usage today screenshot the charts or ask support for a manual dump. Finance needs a self-serve CSV for any closed billing period.
strings.issue:NMB-156:desc:1: On the usage page, “Download CSV” lists closed periods (up to 24 months). Selecting one generates a file with columns: date, meter_name, quantity, unit, workspace_id, project_id. Generation is async for files over ~5MB with an email to the requester at billing@example.com style addresses on the account.
strings.issue:NMB-156:desc:2: Done when downloads match the numbers on the usage chart within 0.5%, in-progress periods are disabled, and only billing_admin and owner roles see the control.
strings.issue:NMB-157:title: Allow pinning an editor template as the default for new documents
strings.issue:NMB-157:desc:0: Teams standardize on a few document templates but still pick the template manually every time. New docs often start blank and get reformatted later.
strings.issue:NMB-157:desc:1: From the template gallery, allow “Set as default for new documents” scoped to a project (or workspace if no project context). The new-doc modal preselects that template and can still switch. Defaults are role-aware: editors and above can set project defaults; only admins set workspace defaults.
strings.issue:NMB-157:desc:2: Acceptance: clearing the default restores the blank doc, API exposes default_template_id on project settings, and mobile new-doc flow honors the same default.
strings.issue:NMB-158:title: Add a dashboard widget that lists issues blocked for more than 7 days
strings.issue:NMB-158:desc:0: Blocked work ages quietly on boards. Managers want a dashboard signal when cards sit in a blocked state longer than a week without scanning every column.
strings.issue:NMB-158:desc:1: New widget “Long-blocked issues” queries cards where blocked=true (or status category blocked) and blocked_since < now() - 7 days. List shows title, board, age in days, and blocker reason if present; click opens the card. Configurable threshold defaulting to 7 with options 3 / 7 / 14.
strings.issue:NMB-158:desc:2: Ship when empty state explains “No cards blocked beyond threshold”, refresh matches other list widgets (5 min), and the widget respects board-level permissions of the viewer.
strings.issue:NMB-159:title: Let users configure quiet hours for desktop and mobile push alerts
strings.issue:NMB-159:desc:0: Push alerts fire at all hours. Users want a quiet window for desktop and mobile independently so overnight pings stop without disabling notifications entirely.
strings.issue:NMB-159:desc:1: Under notification preferences, add Quiet hours with start/end times, timezone (default profile TZ), and channel toggles for desktop push vs mobile push. During the window, pushes are held and delivered as a single summary at window end unless the event is marked critical (security alerts).
strings.issue:NMB-159:desc:2: Criteria: server-side enforcement so background workers do not bypass the client, preview of next quiet window on the settings page, and an escape hatch “Allow critical” defaulting to on.
strings.issue:NMB-16:title: Document CSV export in the public reference
strings.issue:NMB-16:desc:0: Context: Document CSV export in the public reference.
strings.issue:NMB-16:desc:1: Acceptance: behaviour is covered by a test and documented in the reference.
strings.issue:NMB-160:title: Support importing a board from a CSV with custom field mapping
strings.issue:NMB-160:desc:0: Importing boards from spreadsheets currently forces a fixed column map and drops unknown headers. Customers migrating from other tools need to bind CSV columns to Nimbus fields including custom fields.
strings.issue:NMB-160:desc:1: Import wizard: upload CSV (max 10k rows), auto-detect headers, then a mapping UI from each column to title, description, status, assignee email, due date, or a custom field key. Unmapped columns can be ignored or attached as labels. Dry-run reports row errors before commit.
strings.issue:NMB-160:desc:2: Released when sample CSVs for two common board-tool exports are in docs, failed rows download as a residual CSV, and the bulk import worker emits progress on the existing job status channel.
strings.issue:NMB-161:title: Show password strength and common-breach checks on the signup form
strings.issue:NMB-161:desc:0: Signup only checks minimum length today. Weak and previously breached passwords still get accepted until a later forced reset.
strings.issue:NMB-161:desc:1: On the signup password field, show a strength meter (entropy-style score 0–4) and an async check against our common-breach bloom filter service. Block submit on score < 2 or a breach hit; show actionable guidance without listing the password in logs.
strings.issue:NMB-161:desc:2: Done when the check debounces at 300ms, fails open with a warning if the breach service times out after 800ms, and the same component is reused on password change.
strings.issue:NMB-162:title: Allow filtering the notification feed by project and event type
strings.issue:NMB-162:desc:0: The notification feed mixes every project and event type into one stream. People watching a single launch project cannot isolate signal from noise.
strings.issue:NMB-162:desc:1: Add filter chips and a filter panel: multi-select projects the user belongs to, and event types (assignment, mention, status change, due soon, billing). Filters persist in local storage per user and apply to both inbox and the full feed page. Unread badge counts remain global unless “count only filtered” is toggled later—out of scope here.
strings.issue:NMB-162:desc:2: Complete when deep links preserve filter query params, empty states explain active filters, and API GET /notifications accepts project_ids[] and types[] with a 100-item page size.
strings.issue:NMB-163:title: Let power users define reusable dashboard layouts shared with the team
strings.issue:NMB-163:desc:0: Individuals rearrange dashboards carefully, then teammates rebuild the same layout by hand. Teams want a shared layout object they can apply without copying widget JSON.
strings.issue:NMB-163:desc:1: Allow power users (dashboard:admin) to save the current layout as a named reusable layout, optionally share it with the workspace. Others can “Apply layout” which clones widget config and queries but not live filter personalization. Version field increments on overwrite.
strings.issue:NMB-163:desc:2: Acceptance: max 25 shared layouts per workspace, apply is undoable for 30s, and personal drafts stay private until shared.
strings.issue:NMB-164:title: Add an accessibility audit checklist panel for published documents
strings.issue:NMB-164:desc:0: Published docs go out without a consistent accessibility pass. Authors ask for an in-product checklist instead of an external spreadsheet.
strings.issue:NMB-164:desc:1: Add a side panel “Accessibility audit” on published (and publish-preview) documents: automated checks for missing alt text, heading order gaps, low-contrast text tokens we control, and link text like “click here”. Each item is pass/fail with jump-to-node. Manual checklist items (keyboard walkthrough, screen reader spot check) can be ticked by the author and stored on the publish record.
strings.issue:NMB-164:desc:2: Shipped when publish is not hard-blocked by fails (warn only), the panel is keyboard accessible, and results appear in the publish history snapshot.
strings.issue:NMB-165:title: Surface trial days remaining as a non-blocking banner for workspace owners
strings.issue:NMB-165:desc:0: Trial end currently surprises owners at conversion or via a single email. Owners want a calm, persistent reminder of days left without modal interruption.
strings.issue:NMB-165:desc:1: Show a non-blocking banner for workspace owners (and billing admins) when trial_ends_at is within the trial window: “N days left in your trial” with links to compare plans and manage billing. Dismiss lasts 24 hours; banner returns until conversion or expiry. At 3 days and 1 day, emphasize urgency with stronger but still non-modal styling.
strings.issue:NMB-165:desc:2: Done when the banner never appears for converted workspaces, respects role checks, and is hidden inside public share views.
strings.issue:NMB-166:title: Let users mirror a single list column into another workspace as read-only
strings.issue:NMB-166:desc:0: Cross-workspace visibility today requires dual membership and manual sync. Some programs need a single list column visible elsewhere without granting write access.
strings.issue:NMB-166:desc:1: From a list column menu, “Mirror to workspace…” creates a read-only mirrored column in a target workspace the actor admins. Card titles, status, and assignees replicate one-way within 2 minutes; edits in the source propagate, edits in the mirror are rejected. Break-mirror is available on either side with confirmation.
strings.issue:NMB-166:desc:2: Released when audit logs record mirror create/break, attachments are metadata-only (no binary clone) in v1, and cycle detection blocks A→B→A setups.
strings.issue:NMB-167:title: Allow attaching a payment method without immediately changing the plan
strings.issue:NMB-167:desc:0: Storing a payment method today still routes through the change-plan checkout sheet, which scares teams who only want a backup instrument on file before renewal.
strings.issue:NMB-167:desc:1: Split the flow: “Add payment method” stores the instrument via the billing provider setup intent without changing plan_id or triggering proration. Plan changes stay on a separate “Change plan” path that can reuse the default method.
strings.issue:NMB-167:desc:2: Acceptance: users with a method and no plan change see no invoice preview; failed setup intents do not leave orphan customer objects; the settings page shows methods with a default star independent of plan tier.
strings.issue:NMB-168:title: Add slash-command shortcuts for inserting date chips with relative offsets
strings.issue:NMB-168:desc:0: Inserting dates in docs requires the date picker or typing a full ISO string. Writers want relative shortcuts while outlining schedules.
strings.issue:NMB-168:desc:1: Slash commands: /date, /today, /tomorrow, /+3d, /-1w insert date chips with the resolved calendar day stored in UTC midnight of the workspace TZ, displayed in the viewer’s locale. Chips remain updateable via the existing date popover.
strings.issue:NMB-168:desc:2: Complete when invalid offsets show inline errors, commands appear in the slash palette with examples, and collaborative peers see the same absolute day.
strings.issue:NMB-169:title: Let admins require MFA for any role at or above editor
strings.issue:NMB-169:desc:0: Workspace MFA can be optional today even for roles that can edit production content. Admins in stricter environments need to require MFA for editor and any higher privilege role.
strings.issue:NMB-169:desc:1: Auth policy setting: minimum_mfa_role = editor | admin | owner | off. Members at or above that role who lack a verified second factor are put into a soft-gate on next session: they can only reach MFA enrollment until complete. API tokens minted before enrollment keep working until expiry but cannot create new long-lived tokens.
strings.issue:NMB-169:desc:2: Backlog-ready acceptance sketch: grace period option of 0 or 7 days, owner cannot lock themselves out without a recovery code path, and directory-synced users follow the same gate.
strings.issue:NMB-17:title: onboarding checklist renders stale data after an update
strings.issue:NMB-17:desc:0: Steps to reproduce: open onboarding checklist with a workspace that has more than one member.
strings.issue:NMB-17:desc:1: Expected: the view keeps the selected filters after a reload.
strings.issue:NMB-17:desc:2: Actual: filters reset to the default and the row count changes.
strings.issue:NMB-17:desc:3: Impact: reported by two customers this week; no data loss observed.
strings.issue:NMB-170:title: Show a changelog drawer for document versions without leaving the editor
strings.issue:NMB-170:desc:0: Version history currently navigates authors away from the editing surface into a separate history route, breaking flow during reviews.
strings.issue:NMB-170:desc:1: Add a changelog drawer anchored to the editor chrome listing versions with actor, timestamp, and optional message. Selecting a version shows a read-only preview beside the live doc; restore remains a two-click confirm. Drawer can stay open while the user continues editing the live version.
strings.issue:NMB-170:desc:2: Success metrics: opening history no longer unmounts the editor session, keyboard Esc closes the drawer, and large docs (500+ versions) virtualize the list.
strings.issue:NMB-171:title: Allow muting notifications for a specific card until it is reassigned
strings.issue:NMB-171:desc:0: Watching a noisy card floods the inbox when the user only cares after ownership moves. Muting the whole board is too broad; unwatching loses future reassignment signals they do want.
strings.issue:NMB-171:desc:1: Per-card control: “Mute until reassigned” suppresses notifications for that card_id for the current user until assignee_id changes, then automatically clears the mute and delivers a single reassignment notification. Manual unmute is always available on the card and in notification settings under Active mutes.
strings.issue:NMB-171:desc:2: Acceptance: mutes sync across devices, do not affect other watchers, and expire after 90 days of no reassignment with an optional reminder.
strings.issue:NMB-172:title: Add integration tests for the bulk import worker
strings.issue:NMB-172:desc:0: The bulk import worker has grown edge cases (custom field mapping, partial row failure, assignee email resolution) but still relies on manual staging runs. Regressions slip into release candidates.
strings.issue:NMB-172:desc:1: Done when we have an integration suite under workers/import that spins the worker against a test database and fixture CSVs: happy path 100 rows, malformed custom field, unknown assignee skip, 10k-row performance budget under 60s wall time in CI, and poison-message retry. Suite runs in CI on workers package changes.
strings.issue:NMB-173:title: Migrate dashboard chart tooltips to the shared floating-ui primitives
strings.issue:NMB-173:desc:0: Dashboard chart tooltips still mount a one-off positioning helper that diverges from the shared floating primitives used by the rest of the app. Arrow placement and collision behavior disagree with design system defaults, and the helper breaks under strict mode double-mount.
strings.issue:NMB-173:desc:1: Complete when all chart tooltip surfaces (velocity, burndown, distribution, usage) use the shared portal plus offset middleware, visual regression screenshots update, and the legacy tooltip position utility is deleted from the dashboard package with no remaining imports.
strings.issue:NMB-174:title: Document the editor collaborative protocol handshake for SDK consumers
strings.issue:NMB-174:desc:0: SDK partners keep filing support tickets because the collab handshake sequence lives only in a private design doc from Q3 2024. Without a public reference, integrators reverse-engineer the wire format from packet captures and ship clients that break when we rotate the protocol minor version.
strings.issue:NMB-174:desc:1: Publish a dedicated section under docs/sdk/collab covering the three-phase handshake: HELLO with clientCapabilities, READY with serverEpoch and presenceLeaseMs, then the first presence snapshot. Include the exact JSON shapes for each frame type and the 2.1-second timeout before the gateway tears down an incomplete session.
strings.issue:NMB-174:desc:2: Done when the page is linked from the SDK README, includes at least one annotated sequence diagram, and a sample Node snippet that completes the handshake against wss://collab.example.com/v1. Review sign-off from Editor platform and DevRel.
strings.issue:NMB-175:title: Extract billing proration helpers into a shared package with unit coverage
strings.issue:NMB-175:desc:0: Proration math is duplicated in billing-service, the invoice worker, and the admin CLI. Three implementations already disagree on mid-cycle seat changes: the service rounds half-up after tax, the worker rounds before tax, and the CLI skips partial-day credits entirely.
strings.issue:NMB-175:desc:1: Move calculateSeatProration, applyCreditBalance, and buildProrationLineItems into @nimbus/billing-proration with a pure unit suite covering 0-day, single-day, leap-day, and multi-currency inputs. Call sites import the package and delete their local copies.
strings.issue:NMB-176:title: Replace legacy localStorage auth tokens with the httpOnly session cookie path
strings.issue:NMB-176:desc:0: Auth tokens still land in localStorage under nimbus.session.v1. Any XSS on a marketing subdomain can steal long-lived bearer strings and call the Graph API as the victim until the 14-day TTL expires.
strings.issue:NMB-176:desc:1: Switch the web app to the httpOnly session cookie path already used by the mobile BFF: Set-Cookie with Secure, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, and a 12-hour sliding max-age. Drop the Authorization header injection from the SPA bootstrap and rely on credentials: include for same-site calls.
strings.issue:NMB-176:desc:2: Complete when localStorage no longer holds session material, CSRF double-submit is wired for mutating POSTs, and the auth smoke suite passes on Chrome and Safari.
strings.issue:NMB-177:title: Add Storybook stories for notification toast variants and stacking rules
strings.issue:NMB-177:desc:0: Notification toasts have four visual variants and a stacking policy that only exists as tribal knowledge in the Notifications channel. Design reviews keep regressing spacing when engineers guess the rules.
strings.issue:NMB-177:desc:1: Add Storybook stories for success, warning, error, and info toasts, plus a multi-toast canvas that exercises the 3-toast max stack, 280ms enter/exit, and bottom-right collision with the help FAB. Document the z-index band 1200–1290 in the story description.
strings.issue:NMB-177:desc:2: Acceptance: stories render under Chromatic, stacking story matches the Figma density spec within 2px, and the Notifications README links to the Storybook path.
strings.issue:NMB-178:title: Wire axe accessibility checks into the Dashboard CI smoke suite
strings.issue:NMB-178:desc:0: Dashboard CI only runs unit and visual snapshot jobs. Accessibility regressions — missing labels on the filter drawer, contrast failures on the density toggle — ship unnoticed until a customer files a ticket.
strings.issue:NMB-178:desc:1: Wire axe-core into the existing Playwright smoke suite for the four primary Dashboard routes: /board, /timeline, /reports, and /settings/workspace. Fail the job on any serious or critical violation; log moderate findings without blocking.
strings.issue:NMB-178:desc:2: Done when the smoke workflow posts an axe summary artifact and at least one intentional a11y failure is proven to red the pipeline in a dry-run PR.
strings.issue:NMB-179:title: Refactor workspace scope middleware to accept multi-tenant request contexts
strings.issue:NMB-179:desc:0: Workspace scope middleware assumed a single tenantId per request, pulled from the JWT claim alone. Multi-tenant service accounts that act across several workspaces in one call hit 403s because the middleware overwrote the ambient scope on the first membership check.
strings.issue:NMB-179:desc:1: Refactor resolveWorkspaceScope to accept an optional RequestContext with tenantIds[], actorType, and impersonationFlag. Membership resolution unions the allowed set rather than short-circuiting on the first match. Keep the single-tenant path as a thin wrapper so existing handlers stay untouched.
strings.issue:NMB-179:desc:2: Complete when integration tests cover three tenants in one request, the impersonation audit log still records each workspace id, and p95 latency on the middleware stays under 4ms on staging.
strings.issue:NMB-18:title: CSV export returns results in a nondeterministic order
strings.issue:NMB-18:desc:0: Steps to reproduce: open CSV export with a workspace that has more than one member.
strings.issue:NMB-18:desc:1: Expected: the view keeps the selected filters after a reload.
strings.issue:NMB-18:desc:2: Actual: filters reset to the default and the row count changes.
strings.issue:NMB-18:desc:3: Impact: reported by two customers this week; no data loss observed.
strings.issue:NMB-180:title: Remove the deprecated filter chip color tokens from the design system
strings.issue:NMB-180:desc:0: Filter chip color tokens --chip-filter-bg-legacy and --chip-filter-fg-muted-v1 still ship in the design-system CSS bundle even though no product surface imports them after the 2025 palette refresh. They inflate the token dump and confuse designers scanning the Figma-to-code map.
strings.issue:NMB-180:desc:1: Delete the deprecated token definitions, remove them from the theme export map, and bump the design-system minor so consumers that still reference them get a clear compile break rather than silent fallbacks.
strings.issue:NMB-181:title: Add performance budgets for the editor initial paint on mid-tier laptops
strings.issue:NMB-181:desc:0: Editor first paint on mid-tier laptops (Intel i5-1135G7 class, 16GB RAM) regularly exceeds 3.2s LCP in field data, yet we have no CI gate that fails when a PR worsens that path. Mobile budgets exist; desktop editor is unchecked.
strings.issue:NMB-181:desc:1: Add a Lighthouse CI budget job targeting the editor route with CPU 4x throttle and 4G Fast profile. Cap initial paint at 2.4s, TBT at 350ms, and total JS transferred at 420 KiB for the editor chunk graph.
strings.issue:NMB-181:desc:2: Complete when the budget file lives in tooling/perf/editor-budget.json, the job runs on every editor-package PR, and the baseline commit is recorded in the perf dashboard.
strings.issue:NMB-182:title: Generate OpenAPI types for the billing portal session create endpoint
strings.issue:NMB-182:desc:0: The billing portal session create endpoint (POST /v1/billing/portal-sessions) has an OpenAPI path but clients still hand-write request and response types. Drift between the YAML and TypeScript caused two production 400s last quarter when returnUrl became required.
strings.issue:NMB-182:desc:1: Generate TypeScript types from the OpenAPI document into packages/billing-api-types using openapi-typescript, export CreatePortalSessionRequest and CreatePortalSessionResponse, and wire the portal client to consume them. Add a CI check that fails if the generated file is stale relative to the YAML.
strings.issue:NMB-182:desc:2: Done when the generator runs in the billing package build, consumers import from @nimbus/billing-api-types, and the stale-check job is green on main.
strings.issue:NMB-183:title: Backfill missing notification preference rows for workspaces created before 2025
strings.issue:NMB-183:desc:0: Workspaces created before 2025-01-01 never received rows in notification_preferences. Those accounts fall through to hard-coded defaults in the notification service, so product changes to default digests never reach them and support cannot toggle channels per workspace.
strings.issue:NMB-183:desc:1: Backfill one preference row per (workspace_id, channel) for email, in_app, and slack with digest_frequency=weekly and quiet_hours_enabled=false. Run in batches of 2_500 workspaces with a 150ms pause to keep write IOPS under the RDS alert threshold. Idempotent on workspace_id+channel unique key.
strings.issue:NMB-184:title: Split the dashboard data loader into parallel queries with a shared cache key
strings.issue:NMB-184:desc:0: The dashboard data loader issued sequential queries for boards, members, and activity, totaling ~640ms p95 on warm cache. That waterfall blocked first contentful paint for the board shell even when each individual query was cheap.
strings.issue:NMB-184:desc:1: Split loadDashboardBootstrap into three parallel queries sharing a composite cache key workspace:{id}:dash:v3 with a 45-second TTL. Member and activity slices may stale-serve while boards always revalidate on focus.
strings.issue:NMB-184:desc:2: Complete when the bootstrap path is under 280ms p95 on staging with the shared key, and cache invalidation still fires on board create/archive events.
strings.issue:NMB-185:title: Add Playwright coverage for OAuth callback deep-link restoration
strings.issue:NMB-185:desc:0: OAuth callback deep-link restoration has no automated coverage. Manual checks miss the case where the pre-login path includes a query string and hash, so users land on /home instead of the board they were invited to.
strings.issue:NMB-185:desc:1: Add Playwright specs that start at /oauth/start?return_to= encoded board URLs, complete the mock IdP flow, and assert the final location restores path, search, and hash. Cover both the happy path and an expired state parameter that must bounce to login with an error banner.
strings.issue:NMB-186:title: Upgrade the markdown sanitizer and update snapshot tests for callout blocks
strings.issue:NMB-186:desc:0: The markdown sanitizer is two major versions behind and strips the new callout block syntax that the editor has emitted since 2025.08. Pasted callouts render as plain paragraphs, and snapshot tests still assert the old stripped output.
strings.issue:NMB-186:desc:1: Upgrade sanitize-md to 4.6.x, enable the callout extension with allowed types note|warning|tip|danger, and regenerate editor snapshot fixtures for fixtures/callouts/*.md. Confirm script and iframe tags remain stripped under the new defaults.
strings.issue:NMB-186:desc:2: Done when all editor package snapshots pass, the upgrade note is in the changelog, and a security smoke confirms no new tag allowlist expansion beyond callouts.
strings.issue:NMB-187:title: Instrument billing webhook handlers with structured latency histograms
strings.issue:NMB-187:desc:0: Billing webhook handlers only emit counter metrics for success/failure. When payment events pile up, we cannot tell whether latency lives in signature verification, payload parse, or the ledger write — paging on error rate alone is too late.
strings.issue:NMB-187:desc:1: Instrument each handler stage with structured histograms: billing.webhook.verify_ms, billing.webhook.parse_ms, and billing.webhook.persist_ms, labeled by event_type and outcome. Export via the existing OTel pipeline with 50/90/99 quantiles.
strings.issue:NMB-187:desc:2: Acceptance: dashboards show the three stages for invoice.paid and customer.subscription.updated, and an alert fires when p99 of persist_ms exceeds 800ms for 5 minutes.
strings.issue:NMB-188:title: Delete unused CSS modules from the pre-2025 editor shell
strings.issue:NMB-188:desc:0: The pre-2025 editor shell left behind 14 CSS modules under packages/editor/src/shell-legacy that no component imports. They still get swept into Storybook's CSS graph and confuse new hires scanning the tree.
strings.issue:NMB-188:desc:1: Delete the unused modules, remove any orphan className string references in dead test helpers, and confirm the editor production bundle size drops by the measured ~11 KiB gzip.
strings.issue:NMB-189:title: Add a feature flag gate for the compact board density experiment
strings.issue:NMB-189:desc:0: The compact board density experiment needs a server-evaluated flag so we can ramp 0→50% of workspaces without a client deploy. Hard-coding the density class in the board shell blocks controlled rollout and clean kill-switch.
strings.issue:NMB-189:desc:1: Add feature flag board_density_compact via the existing flag service, evaluate it in the dashboard bootstrap payload as density: 'compact' | 'comfortable', and gate the CSS density data-attribute on that value. Default off for all workspaces.
strings.issue:NMB-189:desc:2: Complete when flag admin can target by workspace id and plan tier, client respects the bootstrap field without a local override, and kill-switch to off restores comfortable density within one refresh.
strings.issue:NMB-19:title: dashboard filter chips loses state after a browser refresh
strings.issue:NMB-19:desc:0: Steps to reproduce: open dashboard filter chips with a workspace that has more than one member.
strings.issue:NMB-19:desc:1: Expected: the view keeps the selected filters after a reload.
strings.issue:NMB-19:desc:2: Actual: filters reset to the default and the row count changes.
strings.issue:NMB-19:desc:3: Impact: reported by two customers this week; no data loss observed.
strings.issue:NMB-190:title: Document keyboard shortcuts in the in-app help drawer data source
strings.issue:NMB-190:desc:0: Keyboard shortcuts for the editor only appear in an external PDF that support links out of product. In-app help drawer lists empty under the Shortcuts section because the data source never received the editor bindings.
strings.issue:NMB-190:desc:1: Extend help-drawer/shortcuts.json with the editor set: Cmd/Ctrl+B/I/U, Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+C for code block, Cmd/Ctrl+Alt+M for comment, and / for the slash menu. Platform-specific labels must resolve from the user agent so Mac and Windows strings stay correct.
strings.issue:NMB-190:desc:2: Done when the help drawer Shortcuts tab shows the editor group, search finds 'code block', and a unit test freezes the JSON shape against schema version 3.
strings.issue:NMB-191:title: Normalize timezone conversion helpers used by dashboard date ranges
strings.issue:NMB-191:desc:0: Dashboard date range pickers call three different timezone helpers: one in reports, one in activity, and a copy-pasted function in the board filter bar. They disagree on DST boundaries, so a 'last 7 days' range can shift by an hour depending on which widget you open.
strings.issue:NMB-191:desc:1: Consolidate on toWorkspaceRange(start, end, workspaceTz) in @nimbus/time, delete the local helpers, and make every dashboard date control go through that API. Unit coverage must include America/Santiago spring-forward and Europe/Paris fall-back for March/October 2025.
strings.issue:NMB-192:title: Add contract tests between the editor presence channel and the gateway
strings.issue:NMB-192:desc:0: Editor presence frames and the collab gateway have drifted twice this year — once on the peer color field rename, once when leaseMs became required. Manual QA caught both late.
strings.issue:NMB-192:desc:1: Add contract tests that load the presence protobuf/JSON schema from the gateway repo as a git submodule pin, generate fixtures, and assert the editor client encoder/decoder round-trips PresenceJoin, PresenceCursor, and PresenceLeave without dropping fields.
strings.issue:NMB-192:desc:2: Complete when CI fails if the submodule pin advances with a breaking schema change the client has not adapted, and the suite runs under packages/editor-presence in under 8 seconds.
strings.issue:NMB-193:title: Migrate notification email templates to the shared MJML layout
strings.issue:NMB-193:desc:0: Notification emails still use per-template HTML with inconsistent header/footer markup. Brand updates require touching 11 files, and three templates still miss the unsubscribe footer required by our ESP policy.
strings.issue:NMB-193:desc:1: Migrate all notification email templates to the shared MJML layout (layouts/base.mjml) with slots for preheader, body, and footer. Convert issue_assigned, mention, digest_weekly, and export_ready first; remaining seven follow in the same PR if diff stays reviewable.
strings.issue:NMB-193:desc:2: Done when every template renders through the MJML pipeline, litmus previews match design within the approved tolerance, and the ESP link-scan for unsubscribe succeeds on all of them.
strings.issue:NMB-194:title: Dashboard polish and reliability
strings.issue:NMB-194:desc:0: Raise the quality bar on the main Nimbus dashboard: filter state, chart layout, workspace switching, density modes, and empty states. This initiative covers the daily board experience customers open first and aims to cut p95 interaction jank on common paths.
strings.issue:NMB-195:title: Billing reliability
strings.issue:NMB-195:desc:0: Make billing flows trustworthy end to end: invoices, portal sessions, usage meters, receipts, payment methods, and plan changes. Support and finance both treat billing bugs as P1 noise, so this epic groups the reliability fixes customers hit when they pay us.
strings.issue:NMB-196:title: Editor performance push
strings.issue:NMB-196:desc:0: Speed up and stabilize the collaborative editor: autosave correctness, mention UX, undo/redo, cursors, tables, and large paste paths. Editors are where customers spend the most continuous time; regressions here show up as silent data loss reports.
strings.issue:NMB-197:title: Notification overhaul
strings.issue:NMB-197:desc:0: Rebuild notification delivery so toasts, badges, digests, quiet hours, and preference toggles stay consistent across sessions. The goal is fewer muted workspaces and fewer duplicate digests after the midnight boundary bugs.
strings.issue:NMB-198:title: Auth hardening
strings.issue:NMB-198:desc:0: Harden login, session renewal, SSO, OAuth callbacks, MFA policy, and password reset so identity edge cases stop generating security tickets. Scope is product-auth for the web app, not the support portal subdomain.
strings.issue:NMB-199:title: Workspace data export foundations
strings.issue:NMB-199:desc:0: Close gaps around bulk archive, CSV export and import, bulk reassignment, and shared worker test coverage. These paths are rare but high-blast-radius when they fail, and they currently lack shared fixtures.

strings.issue:NMS-100:desc:3: Impact: reported by two customers this week; no data loss observed.

strings.issue:NMS-101:desc:2: Actual: filters reset to the default and the row count changes.

strings.issue:NMS-102:desc:0: Context: Instrument invoice shows wrong currency with structured logs.
strings.issue:NMS-102:desc:1: Acceptance: behaviour is covered by a test and documented in the reference.
