strings.issue:NMS-103:desc:0: Steps to reproduce: open duplicate notification emails with a workspace that has more than one member.
strings.issue:NMS-103:desc:1: Expected: the view keeps the selected filters after a reload.
strings.issue:NMS-103:desc:2: Actual: filters reset to the default and the row count changes.
strings.issue:NMS-103:desc:3: Impact: reported by two customers this week; no data loss observed.
strings.issue:NMS-104:title: Customer cannot download invoice after plan change mid-cycle
strings.issue:NMS-104:desc:0: After a mid-cycle plan change, some customers cannot download the current invoice from the Billing Questions portal action.
strings.issue:NMS-104:desc:1: The download button returns a generic failure and the browser network tab shows a 404 for the invoice PDF resource id generated at plan change time.
strings.issue:NMS-104:desc:2: Reproduce with a sandbox account that upgrades mid-cycle, capture the resource id mapping, and fix generation so post-change invoices remain downloadable.
strings.issue:NMS-105:title: Support portal ticket status stuck on Waiting despite agent reply
strings.issue:NMS-105:desc:0: Tickets in the support portal remain stuck on Waiting even after an agent posts a public reply that should move them to Pending customer or Open.
strings.issue:NMS-105:desc:1: Status transition logs show the reply event without a matching status update when the ticket was previously Waiting on customer.
strings.issue:NMS-105:desc:2: Identify the race between the reply writer and the status machine and ensure agent replies always advance status for portal-visible tickets.
strings.issue:NMS-106:title: Escalation auto-assign skips the on-call rotation for EU overnight hours
strings.issue:NMS-106:desc:0: Escalation auto-assign skipped the EU overnight on-call rotation and assigned tickets to the previous daytime owner.
strings.issue:NMS-106:desc:1: Rotation schedule entries for EU overnight were present but the assigner used UTC day boundaries incorrectly when selecting the active shift.
strings.issue:NMS-106:desc:2: Correct the timezone handling, add fixture coverage for overnight EU windows, and reassign any tickets misrouted during the affected nights.
strings.issue:NMS-107:title: Billing question form drops the attached screenshot on mobile Safari
strings.issue:NMS-107:desc:0: On mobile Safari the Billing Questions form accepts a screenshot attachment in the UI but submits the ticket without the file.
strings.issue:NMS-107:desc:1: Desktop browsers upload the same image successfully, pointing to a multipart boundary or file input reset issue on iOS Safari.
strings.issue:NMS-107:desc:2: Fix the client upload path for mobile Safari and add a device-level check that blocks submit when the attachment preview is present but the file blob is missing.
strings.issue:NMS-108:title: Customer reports missing issues after workspace merge completed green
strings.issue:NMS-108:desc:0: A customer reports issues missing from the target workspace after a workspace merge that completed with a green status.
strings.issue:NMS-108:desc:1: Merge job logs show success counts that do not match the source issue inventory, suggesting skipped projects or a partial project remapping.
strings.issue:NMS-108:desc:2: Audit the merge job for silent skip paths, restore missing issues from backups if needed, and fail the merge job when inventory checks do not reconcile.
strings.issue:NMS-109:title: Triage queue sorts by last updated instead of first response SLA
strings.issue:NMS-109:desc:0: The triage queue UI sorts tickets by last updated time instead of first response SLA remaining, so newest activity floats above breaches.
strings.issue:NMS-109:desc:1: Agents miss SLA risk tickets that have not been touched recently because the default sort no longer matches the SLA board contract.
strings.issue:NMS-109:desc:2: Restore first response SLA as the default sort, keep last updated as an optional column sort, and add a regression test for the default ordering.
strings.issue:NMS-11:title: Instrument customer cannot log in with structured logs
strings.issue:NMS-11:desc:0: Context: Instrument customer cannot log in with structured logs.
strings.issue:NMS-11:desc:1: Acceptance: behaviour is covered by a test and documented in the reference.
strings.issue:NMS-110:title: Escalation email goes to the previous owner after a handoff
strings.issue:NMS-110:desc:0: After an escalation handoff, notification email still goes to the previous owner instead of the new assignee.
strings.issue:NMS-110:desc:1: The handoff updates the ticket owner field but the escalation mailer reads a cached owner snapshot from the escalation record.
strings.issue:NMS-110:desc:2: Refresh the owner snapshot on handoff and resend any misdirected notifications identified in the audit window.
strings.issue:NMS-111:title: Support macros insert outdated refund policy text from 2025
strings.issue:NMS-111:desc:0: Support macros still insert refund policy text dated 2025 that legal retired after the policy refresh.
strings.issue:NMS-111:desc:1: Agents using the macros send outdated refund windows and eligibility language to customers on the portal.
strings.issue:NMS-111:desc:2: Update macro content to the current policy, add a review date field so stale macros surface in admin, and notify teams that reused the old text.
strings.issue:NMS-112:title: Customer SSO login fails only on the support portal subdomain
strings.issue:NMS-112:desc:0: Customer SSO login succeeds on the main app domain but fails only on the support portal subdomain with a generic authentication error.
strings.issue:NMS-112:desc:1: ACS URL configuration for the portal subdomain appears out of sync with the identity provider metadata customers download from example.com docs.
strings.issue:NMS-112:desc:2: Align portal SAML endpoints with the documented ACS URLs, improve error messages for ACS mismatch, and provide a self-serve metadata check.
strings.issue:NMS-113:title: Billing proration explanation in the portal mismatches the invoice line items
strings.issue:NMS-113:desc:0: The portal Billing Questions page explains proration with amounts that do not match the invoice line items for the same period.
strings.issue:NMS-113:desc:1: Customers open tickets citing the mismatch even when the invoice itself is correct, driving avoidable support volume.
strings.issue:NMS-113:desc:2: Recalculate the explanation widget from the same proration service used for invoice generation and add a snapshot test for mid-cycle upgrades.
strings.issue:NMS-114:title: Triage labels applied via bulk action do not persist after refresh
strings.issue:NMS-114:desc:0: Triage labels applied through bulk action appear immediately but disappear after a page refresh.
strings.issue:NMS-114:desc:1: Single-ticket label edits persist correctly, isolating the issue to the bulk write path or its response handling.
strings.issue:NMS-114:desc:2: Ensure bulk label mutations commit and invalidate list caches so refresh shows the same labels agents just applied.
strings.issue:NMS-115:title: Escalation timer resets when a public comment is added by the customer
strings.issue:NMS-115:desc:0: When a customer adds a public comment on an escalated ticket, the escalation timer resets to the full SLA window.
strings.issue:NMS-115:desc:1: Timer reset should apply only to agent-owned clocks, not customer comments that should leave the escalation deadline unchanged.
strings.issue:NMS-115:desc:2: Adjust timer rules, backfill incorrectly extended escalations still open, and cover the case in SLA unit tests.
strings.issue:NMS-116:title: Customer cannot reopen a closed ticket from the portal within 24 hours
strings.issue:NMS-116:desc:0: Customers cannot reopen a closed ticket from the portal within the advertised 24-hour window; the reopen control is disabled or returns an error.
strings.issue:NMS-116:desc:1: Server policy allows reopen for 24 hours but the portal client uses a stricter closed-at check based on local time without timezone normalization.
strings.issue:NMS-116:desc:2: Fix the client window calculation, match server policy, and show remaining reopen time clearly on the closed ticket view.
strings.issue:NMS-117:title: Billing questions route to Triage instead of Billing Questions queue
strings.issue:NMS-117:desc:0: Tickets submitted through the Billing Questions form are routed into the general Triage queue instead of the Billing Questions queue.
strings.issue:NMS-117:desc:1: Routing rules still key off an old form id after the form rebuild, so billing work waits behind unrelated triage volume.
strings.issue:NMS-117:desc:2: Update the router mapping for the current form id, move misrouted open tickets, and add a canary assertion on form-to-queue binding.
strings.issue:NMS-118:title: Support search returns tickets from other workspaces for shared domains
strings.issue:NMS-118:desc:0: Support search returns tickets belonging to other workspaces when those workspaces share an email domain with the searching agent tenant.
strings.issue:NMS-118:desc:1: Workspace isolation should scope search hits by workspace id regardless of shared domains on example.com customer contacts.
strings.issue:NMS-118:desc:2: Tighten the search filter, add multi-workspace isolation tests, and audit recent cross-workspace search access logs.
strings.issue:NMS-119:title: Escalation severity dropdown loses the selected value on mobile web
strings.issue:NMS-119:desc:0: On a phone-sized viewport the Escalation severity <select> accepts a tap, briefly shows the chosen rank (e.g. Sev-2), then snaps back to the empty placeholder the moment the picker closes. Reproduced on Chrome 141 for Android and Safari 18 on iOS; desktop widths never misbehave.
strings.issue:NMS-119:desc:1: Agents expect the committed option to stay bound to the form field until they submit or change it again. Instead severity_id is cleared client-side, so the POST body ships null and the API falls back to the workspace default.
strings.issue:NMS-119:desc:2: Hypothesis: the mobile sheet fires a synthetic blur before the change event, and our controlled-component handler reads the still-stale React state when rebuilding options from /escalations/severities. Because the option list is remounted on every blur, the previously selected key is dropped.
strings.issue:NMS-119:desc:3: Impact is confined to mobile web agents creating or editing escalations; roughly two dozen NMS tickets this sprint arrived with the wrong severity and had to be corrected by a lead.
strings.issue:NMS-12:title: Instrument search returns nothing with structured logs
strings.issue:NMS-12:desc:0: Context: Instrument search returns nothing with structured logs.
strings.issue:NMS-12:desc:1: Acceptance: behaviour is covered by a test and documented in the reference.
strings.issue:NMS-120:title: Customer attachment virus scan never completes for files over 8 MB
strings.issue:NMS-120:desc:0: Attachments larger than 8 MB that land on a customer ticket never leave the virus_scan_pending state. Smaller files (we tested 3.2 MB and 7.9 MB PDFs) finish scanning in under 40 seconds and become downloadable; a 8.1 MB zip stays pending indefinitely.
strings.issue:NMS-120:desc:1: Expected: the scan worker marks the object clean or quarantined and flips attachment.scan_status within a few minutes. Actual: the row stays pending, the agent UI shows a spinner forever, and the customer sees "scan in progress" with no retry path.
strings.issue:NMS-120:desc:2: Likely cause is the scan client reusing a single signed GET URL whose expiry is hardcoded to 60 seconds while the AV worker streams the full object through ClamAV. For files past ~8 MB the download exceeds that window, the stream aborts mid-read, and the worker retries with the same expired cursor instead of minting a fresh URL.
strings.issue:NMS-120:desc:3: NMS-facing: three enterprise accounts filed this in the last fortnight. Agents cannot share large diagnostic dumps until scan completes, so escalations stall.
strings.issue:NMS-121:title: Triage SLA breach banner shows for tickets already first-responded
strings.issue:NMS-121:desc:0: The red "SLA breached — first response overdue" banner still appears on triage tickets whose first_response_at is already populated. Spotted on tickets that were answered via the mobile agent app; portal-origin replies seem fine.
strings.issue:NMS-121:desc:1: When first_response_at is non-null the banner and the sla_state=breached badge should both clear. Instead the banner stays and the queue list still paints the ticket crimson even though the detail pane shows a first response timestamp.
strings.issue:NMS-121:desc:2: Working theory: the banner query joins on the first public comment's created_at rather than the denormalized first_response_at column. Mobile replies write first_response_at through a different code path that does not also insert a "public" comment flag the join expects, so the breach view keeps matching.
strings.issue:NMS-122:title: Billing portal shows an unpaid balance after a successful card update
strings.issue:NMS-122:desc:0: After a customer successfully replaces an expired card in the billing portal, the account summary still shows an unpaid balance equal to the last failed invoice amount. Stripe confirms the new payment method and the retry charge succeeds; only our portal balance widget is wrong.
strings.issue:NMS-122:desc:1: Expected: balance_due cents drop to 0 and the "Payment past due" alert disappears once invoice status becomes paid. Actual: GET /billing/summary keeps returning the pre-update balance_due for several hours even though invoices list the charge as paid.
strings.issue:NMS-122:desc:2: Hypothesis: the summary endpoint caches balance_due keyed only by tenant_id with a 6-hour TTL, while the card-update webhook refreshes the invoices collection cache but never busts the summary key. Stale balance wins until the TTL expires or someone hits a forced refresh admin action.
strings.issue:NMS-122:desc:3: Support is fielding NMS tickets from finance contacts who think the charge failed twice. One account attempted a second card update unnecessarily.
strings.issue:NMS-123:title: Escalation template variables render as raw placeholders in outbound email
strings.issue:NMS-123:desc:0: Outbound escalation emails are leaving the system with unsubstituted tokens such as {{ticket.subject}} and {{assignee.display_name}} in the body. Recipients on two NMS accounts forwarded screenshots of the raw placeholders.
strings.issue:NMS-123:desc:1: Template preview inside the admin UI renders correctly. The failure is isolated to the mailer that sends when an escalation is created or severity changes.
strings.issue:NMS-123:desc:2: Suspected root: the new Markdown template compiler returns a structured AST, but the SMTP adapter still calls the old string-replace helper that only understood {{key}} patterns on a flat map. Variable names nested under ticket.* never get walked, so the placeholders pass through untouched.
strings.issue:NMS-123:desc:3: Customer-facing impact is high — external stakeholders receive broken notices and lose confidence in the escalation channel.
strings.issue:NMS-124:title: Customer report of data-loss after bulk archive cannot be reproduced in staging
strings.issue:NMS-124:desc:0: A customer claims that bulk-archiving ~120 closed tickets from their portal removed three tickets that still had open child tasks, and those tickets no longer appear in search or recycle bin. They provided ticket keys NMS-44102 through NMS-44104.
strings.issue:NMS-124:desc:1: We cannot reproduce the loss in staging: bulk archive with the same payload only soft-deletes eligible closed tickets and leaves anything with open children untouched. Staging search still returns the three keys after the same UI steps.
strings.issue:NMS-124:desc:2: Need a production-only investigation path: audit log for bulk_archive on that tenant around 2026-07-28 14:10 UTC, plus a check whether the archive job's eligibility filter ran against a stale read replica that still showed child tasks as done.
strings.issue:NMS-124:desc:3: Until we confirm or rule out hard deletion this stays needs-repro; do not mark data-loss confirmed without production evidence.
strings.issue:NMS-125:title: Support CSAT survey link expires before the configured 14-day window
strings.issue:NMS-125:desc:0: CSAT survey tokens are dying well before the workspace's 14-day window. Customers who open the link on day 6–9 of a closed ticket often land on "This survey is no longer available." Workspace setting csat_link_ttl_days is explicitly 14.
strings.issue:NMS-125:desc:1: Expected lifetime is first_response_or_resolve_time + 14 days. Observed lifetime from token issued_at to reject is closer to 5 days on production.
strings.issue:NMS-125:desc:2: Likely bug: token minting stores expires_at as issued_at + workspace.default_session_ttl_hours (currently 120h) instead of reading csat_link_ttl_days. Session TTL was tightened last release for security and accidentally shortened survey links.
strings.issue:NMS-125:desc:3: NMS volume: about 30 bounce-backs tagged csat-expired in the last week from customers who meant to complete the survey.
strings.issue:NMS-126:title: Triage filter for unassigned tickets includes tickets with a temporary owner
strings.issue:NMS-126:desc:0: The triage queue filter "Unassigned only" still returns tickets that have a temporary owner (owner_type=temp_agent from the overflow rotation). Agents using that filter to pick up free work keep grabbing tickets that already have a short-lived assignee.
strings.issue:NMS-126:desc:1: Expected: only tickets where assignee_id IS NULL. Actual: the filter treats temp_agent ownership as unassigned because the legacy SQL clause was assignee_id IS NULL OR owner_type <> 'agent'.
strings.issue:NMS-126:desc:2: Hypothesis: when temporary ownership landed, owner_type gained temp_agent but the unassigned filter was never updated to treat temp_agent like a real owner. The UI badge shows the temp name while the filter still classifies the row as free.
strings.issue:NMS-126:desc:3: Leads report wasted reassignment churn on the APAC triage queue during peak hours.
strings.issue:NMS-127:title: Billing refund request form rejects valid VAT IDs from certain EU countries
strings.issue:NMS-127:desc:0: The billing refund request form rejects VAT IDs that pass VIES for several EU countries — notably IE (Ireland), AT (Austria), and EL (Greece, using the EL prefix rather than GR). German and French IDs validate fine.
strings.issue:NMS-127:desc:1: Customers enter a well-formed ID such as IE6388047V or EL123456789; the form shows "Invalid VAT ID format" before any network call. Expected: client pattern accepts the country-specific shape, then server confirms via VIES.
strings.issue:NMS-127:desc:2: Root cause was a client regex that assumed every EU VAT ID is [A-Z]{2}[0-9]{8,12}. Irish IDs include a letter check digit and Greek IDs use EL, neither of which the regex allowed. Server-side validator was already correct; only the browser gate was wrong.
strings.issue:NMS-127:desc:3: Blocked legitimate refund filings from at least five NMS billing contacts last month.
strings.issue:NMS-128:title: Escalation chat transcript export truncates the last 20 messages
strings.issue:NMS-128:desc:0: Exporting an escalation chat transcript as PDF or CSV always drops the final ~20 messages even when the live transcript pane shows them. Longer threads (90+ messages) make the gap obvious; short threads under ~25 messages export empty tails or cut mid-conversation.
strings.issue:NMS-128:desc:1: Agents need the full record for handoff and compliance. Export should include every message up to export_requested_at.
strings.issue:NMS-128:desc:2: Cause: the exporter paginated with LIMIT 50 and a forward cursor, then concatenated pages, but the final page used an off-by-one on the exclusive end cursor (message_id < last_seen instead of <=). The last page's newest 20 rows were systematically excluded when the remainder class was non-zero.
strings.issue:NMS-128:desc:3: Compliance asked for re-export on two closed escalations after noticing missing resolution chatter.
strings.issue:NMS-129:title: Customer cannot update the contact email on an open billing dispute
strings.issue:NMS-129:desc:0: On an open billing dispute, the contact email field is read-only in the portal even though the help text says the customer can update it while status is open or needs_info. Closed disputes correctly lock the field; open ones should not.
strings.issue:NMS-129:desc:1: Customers who filed with a shared inbox address cannot redirect notifications to a personal finance alias without calling support to edit the row.
strings.issue:NMS-129:desc:2: Probable cause: the portal form's canEditContact helper returns true only for status=needs_info and forgot open. API PATCH /disputes/{id}/contact-email already allows open; UI is the sole blocker.
strings.issue:NMS-13:title: search returns nothing throws 500 when the workspace has no members
strings.issue:NMS-13:desc:0: Steps to reproduce: open search returns nothing with a workspace that has more than one member.
strings.issue:NMS-13:desc:1: Expected: the view keeps the selected filters after a reload.
strings.issue:NMS-13:desc:2: Actual: filters reset to the default and the row count changes.
strings.issue:NMS-13:desc:3: Impact: reported by two customers this week; no data loss observed.
strings.issue:NMS-130:title: Support knowledge base article links 404 for articles published this week
strings.issue:NMS-130:desc:0: Deep links to knowledge base articles published in the current calendar week return HTTP 404 from the public help host. Older articles (published before Monday 00:00 UTC of the current week) resolve normally.
strings.issue:NMS-130:desc:1: Agents paste these links into ticket replies; customers hit 404 and reply that the article is missing. CDN purge does not help.
strings.issue:NMS-130:desc:2: Hypothesis: the public article router resolves slug via a weekly materialized view refreshed by a Monday cron. Articles inserted after the last refresh exist in the authoring DB and internal preview but are absent from the view the public edge queries.
strings.issue:NMS-130:desc:3: Workaround is linking the internal preview URL, which is undesirable for customers.
strings.issue:NMS-131:title: Triage priority auto-suggest marks every security mention as Highest
strings.issue:NMS-131:desc:0: Triage priority auto-suggest upgrades any ticket whose body or subject contains the substring "security" to Highest, including phrases like "security deposit refund" and "security group misconfiguration for a staging VPC." Real security incidents should still rank high; billing and infra noise should not.
strings.issue:NMS-131:desc:1: Expected: auto-suggest uses the security_incident classifier score (>0.82) rather than a bare keyword. Actual: a case-insensitive contains("security") short-circuit runs before the model and forces Highest.
strings.issue:NMS-131:desc:2: That short-circuit was added during a sev-0 drill and never gated behind the classifier. Removing or narrowing it restores model-based suggestions while keeping an allowlist for phrases like "security breach" and "unauthorized access."
strings.issue:NMS-131:desc:3: Queue leads spent extra time demoting false Highest tickets during Monday triage.
strings.issue:NMS-132:title: Billing double-charge complaint cannot link to the matching invoice ID
strings.issue:NMS-132:desc:0: When filing a billing double-charge complaint, agents cannot attach the matching invoice ID from the search picker. Typing a known invoice number such as inv_7c18a9 returns "No invoices found" even though the same ID opens correctly from the billing admin page.
strings.issue:NMS-132:desc:1: Expected: picker queries invoices for the ticket's tenant and lets the agent bind invoice_id on the complaint record. Actual: the picker always searches the agent's home workspace tenant, not the ticket customer tenant, so cross-tenant billing tickets never resolve IDs.
strings.issue:NMS-132:desc:2: Likely a missing tenant_id query param on GET /billing/invoices/search when invoked from the complaint form; the admin page passes it explicitly.
strings.issue:NMS-133:title: Escalation on-call page mute suppresses all channels instead of SMS only
strings.issue:NMS-133:desc:0: On the escalation on-call page, choosing "Mute SMS for this shift" also silences Slack and email pages. Engineers who only wanted to stop SMS during a meeting missed Slack page storms and email digests.
strings.issue:NMS-133:desc:1: Mute should flip sms_muted=true on the shift record and leave slack_muted / email_muted unchanged. Observed: the toggle writes muted_channels=["sms","slack","email"] because the UI reuses the "mute all" payload shape with a single boolean.
strings.issue:NMS-133:desc:2: Backend already supports per-channel flags; only the on-call settings form collapses them.
strings.issue:NMS-134:title: Customer sees another tenant workspace name briefly on portal load
strings.issue:NMS-134:desc:0: For a brief moment after hard-loading the customer portal, the header shows another tenant's workspace display name before swapping to the correct one. Duration is usually 200–600 ms; long enough for a screenshot and a security-conscious customer to file an NMS ticket.
strings.issue:NMS-134:desc:1: Expected: never paint a workspace name that does not belong to the authenticated session. Actual: first paint uses a cached shell value from localStorage key nimbus.portal.lastWorkspaceLabel without checking it against the session tenant_id.
strings.issue:NMS-134:desc:2: Cross-tenant label flash is a confidentiality concern even if ticket bodies never leak. Session bootstrap should either wait for /me or clear the label when tenant_id mismatches.
strings.issue:NMS-135:title: Support reply drafts autosave overwrites concurrent agent edits
strings.issue:NMS-135:desc:0: When two agents open the same support reply draft, autosave from agent A overwrites agent B's newer keystrokes without merge or conflict UI. Last writer before the 8-second autosave interval wins; the other agent's paragraph disappears on next poll.
strings.issue:NMS-135:desc:1: Expected: either operational transform / CRDT merge, or a conflict banner when revision tokens diverge. Actual: PUT /drafts/{id} is last-write-wins with no If-Match check, and the client blindly replaces local state with the server body on poll.
strings.issue:NMS-135:desc:2: Hypothesis: revision field exists on the draft row but neither the autosave client nor the API enforces it. Concurrent edits during shift overlap (common on Sev-1 threads) silently drop text.
strings.issue:NMS-135:desc:3: Already lost a carefully worded legal reply once; agent had to reconstruct from memory.
strings.issue:NMS-136:title: Triage backlog count includes spam tickets marked for deletion
strings.issue:NMS-136:desc:0: The triage backlog badge count includes tickets already marked spam_pending_deletion. Those rows are hidden from the default queue list but still inflate the number next to "Backlog," so leads think the queue is larger than what agents can see.
strings.issue:NMS-136:desc:1: Count should match the default list filter: exclude status=spam_pending_deletion and deleted_at IS NOT NULL. Current count query only filters deleted_at, so spam marked for purge remains.
strings.issue:NMS-136:desc:2: No customer data issue — pure operator confusion — but it drives unnecessary overtime requests on Monday mornings.
strings.issue:NMS-137:title: Billing question about seat reduction is auto-closed after 48 hours of silence
strings.issue:NMS-137:desc:0: Billing questions whose subject or category is seat reduction are auto-closed by the silence bot after 48 hours without a customer reply, even when an agent is waiting on finance approval and has posted an internal note. Other billing categories use the standard 7-day silence window.
strings.issue:NMS-137:desc:1: Expected: seat-reduction questions follow the same 7-day policy as refund and invoice disputes, or at least respect snooze / waiting_on_internal. Actual: a dedicated rule seat_reduction_silence_hours=48 closes the ticket and sends a "we assume this is resolved" email.
strings.issue:NMS-137:desc:2: That rule was a temporary measure during a pricing launch and was never removed. Customers re-open or file duplicates when finance finally answers.
strings.issue:NMS-138:title: Escalation secondary assignee is not notified when the primary is out of office
strings.issue:NMS-138:desc:0: When the primary escalation assignee has an active out-of-office calendar block, the secondary assignee never receives the reassignment or page notification. The ticket shows secondary on the roster but notification_log has no rows for that user.
strings.issue:NMS-138:desc:1: Expected: OOO on primary triggers notify_secondary with the same channels the primary would have received. Actual: the OOO handler only unassigns primary and leaves secondary without an event, so nobody is paged until a human notices.
strings.issue:NMS-138:desc:2: Likely gap in the OOO workflow step: it updates assignee_id but skips the NotificationFanout call that create-escalation uses for secondaries.
strings.issue:NMS-139:title: Add macros for common billing proration explanations
strings.issue:NMS-139:desc:0: Billing agents retype the same proration explanations on a large share of seat-change and plan-switch tickets. We need shared macros so answers stay consistent and audits can cite a macro_id.
strings.issue:NMS-139:desc:1: Deliver three macros in the billing library: mid-cycle seat increase, mid-cycle seat decrease with credit, and annual-to-monthly switch proration. Each macro should pull {{invoice.next_amount}}, {{proration.credit_cents}}, and {{period.end_date}} from the billing context. Done when macros appear under Billing → Proration and pass a dry-run render against fixture tenant tnt_macros_01.
strings.issue:NMS-14:title: customer cannot log in throws 500 when the workspace has no members
strings.issue:NMS-14:desc:0: Steps to reproduce: open customer cannot log in with a workspace that has more than one member.
strings.issue:NMS-14:desc:1: Expected: the view keeps the selected filters after a reload.
strings.issue:NMS-14:desc:2: Actual: filters reset to the default and the row count changes.
strings.issue:NMS-14:desc:3: Impact: reported by two customers this week; no data loss observed.
strings.issue:NMS-140:title: Document the escalation path for data-loss customer reports
strings.issue:NMS-140:desc:0: When a customer reports possible data-loss, agents currently improvise the escalation path. We need a single internal doc that states severity defaults, who to page, evidence to collect, and when to involve infra versus application on-call.
strings.issue:NMS-140:desc:1: Completion: a published runbook under Support Ops → Escalation titled "Customer data-loss reports," linked from the escalation create form's help popover, covering intake checklist, severity matrix (including when to use Sev-1), communication templates, and post-incident ticket hygiene. Review sign-off from Escalation leads required before marking done.
strings.issue:NMS-141:title: Backfill missing first_response_at timestamps on closed triage tickets
strings.issue:NMS-141:desc:0: About 2,300 closed triage tickets from before the first_response_at backfill job are missing that timestamp even though they have a clear first public agent comment. SLA reporting excludes them or treats them as never-responded.
strings.issue:NMS-141:desc:1: Done when a one-shot migration sets first_response_at from the earliest public agent comment for closed tickets where the column is null, writes a dry-run report of row counts per week, and leaves open tickets untouched for the live writer path. Include a reversible backup table triage_first_response_backfill_2026q2.
strings.issue:NMS-142:title: Create a runbook for verifying portal SSO after IdP certificate rotation
strings.issue:NMS-142:desc:0: After IdP certificate rotations, portal SSO breakages show up as a spike in NMS login tickets. Engineers re-derive the verification steps from memory; we need a durable runbook.
strings.issue:NMS-142:desc:1: Ship a runbook that covers: confirming the new x509 in the IdP metadata URL, updating the portal SSO cert PEM in admin, purging the metadata cache key sso:idp_meta:{workspace_id}, running the /auth/sso/self-check endpoint, and a five-minute canary with a test user. Include rollback (restore previous PEM) and who to page if self-check fails in production.
strings.issue:NMS-143:title: Add CSAT response export for the previous billing quarter
strings.issue:NMS-143:desc:0: Finance wants CSAT responses for the previous billing quarter exported as CSV for the board pack. Today agents can only screenshot dashboards or page through the UI.
strings.issue:NMS-143:desc:1: Done: an export job on the CSAT admin page filtered by response_submitted_at within the selected quarter, columns for ticket_id, score, comment, queue, and billing_account_id, delivered as a downloadable CSV and optionally emailed to the requester. Verified against Q1 fixture data (1,042 rows) matching the dashboard aggregate.
strings.issue:NMS-144:title: Wire support portal audit logs into the shared SIEM pipeline
strings.issue:NMS-144:desc:0: Support portal audit events (login, dispute filed, contact email change, invoice download) currently sit only in the application Postgres audit table. Security wants them in the shared SIEM pipeline alongside app and API logs.
strings.issue:NMS-144:desc:1: Wire the existing audit publisher to emit portal events to the SIEM HTTPS intake with fields actor_id, tenant_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, ip, and user_agent. Acceptance: staging SIEM shows portal.login and portal.dispute.create within 60 seconds of the action, with a runbook snippet for on-call to query them. No change to customer-visible portal behavior.
strings.issue:NMS-145:title: Remove retired escalation severity values from the admin UI
strings.issue:NMS-145:desc:0: Admin UI for escalation severity still lists retired values Sev-0-legacy and experimental-p1 that the API no longer accepts on create. Saving a policy that includes them returns 422 and confuses workspace admins.
strings.issue:NMS-145:desc:1: Remove retired values from the severity multiselect and from the default policy templates. Keep read-only display for historical escalations that still store those codes. Done when the admin form only offers active severities from GET /escalations/severities?status=active and a screenshot checklist is attached for docs.
strings.issue:NMS-146:title: Add Playwright coverage for the billing question multi-step form
strings.issue:NMS-146:desc:0: The billing question multi-step form (category → account picker → details → review) has no Playwright coverage and has regressed twice in the last quarter on step validation.
strings.issue:NMS-146:desc:1: Add a Playwright spec that walks a happy path for category=invoice_discrepancy, asserts step guards when required fields are empty, submits successfully against mocked billing APIs, and checks the confirmation screen shows the new ticket key. Wire it into CI's support-portal project. Done when the spec is green in CI three consecutive main builds.
strings.issue:NMS-147:title: Write agent training notes for workspace merge support scenarios
strings.issue:NMS-147:desc:0: Workspace merge support scenarios (two tenants combining billing and ticket history) generate high-severity NMS threads, but agents lack a single training note describing what merges preserve, what customers must do, and common failure replies.
strings.issue:NMS-147:desc:1: Deliver an internal training note covering pre-merge checklist, post-merge ticket visibility rules, billing invoice ownership, and three sample reply macros. Publish under Agent Academy → Advanced and link from the triage playbook. Done when L&D marks the note required reading for tier-2 agents.
strings.issue:NMS-148:title: Normalize ticket source tags between portal and email intake
strings.issue:NMS-148:desc:0: Tickets created from the portal use source=portal while email intake uses source=email_inbound, but several reports and macros still look for the legacy tags web and mail. Mixed tags break automation that routes portal tickets to the self-serve queue.
strings.issue:NMS-148:desc:1: Normalize on portal and email as the only stored source values; migrate existing web→portal and mail→email_inbound rows; update macros and report definitions. Completion criteria: zero open tickets with legacy tags, and the intake dual-write removed after one release of read-compatible mapping.
strings.issue:NMS-149:title: Add a weekly report of SLA breaches by queue for managers
strings.issue:NMS-149:desc:0: Managers currently export SLA breach CSVs by hand each Monday. They want an automated weekly report grouped by queue.
strings.issue:NMS-149:desc:1: Build a scheduled report that runs Monday 06:00 workspace time, lists breach counts and median minutes past SLA per queue for the prior 7 days, and emails subscribed managers a CSV plus a short HTML summary. Done when two pilot queues (Billing Questions and Triage) receive correct numbers for a shadow week matching the manual export within 1%.
strings.issue:NMS-15:title: Document export never finishes in the public reference
strings.issue:NMS-15:desc:0: Context: Document export never finishes in the public reference.
strings.issue:NMS-15:desc:1: Acceptance: behaviour is covered by a test and documented in the reference.
strings.issue:NMS-150:title: Migrate legacy support macros off the deprecated template engine
strings.issue:NMS-150:desc:0: Sixty-one support macros still compile on the deprecated Mustache-like engine scheduled for removal next quarter. New macros already use the Handlebars-compatible engine; mixed runtimes complicate variable docs.
strings.issue:NMS-150:desc:1: Migrate remaining macros to the new engine, fix variables that relied on implicit HTML escaping differences, and delete the legacy renderer flag. Done when macro_runtime=legacy count is 0 in production and the deprecation banner is removed from the macro editor.
strings.issue:NMS-151:title: Document customer-facing language for rate limit related outages
strings.issue:NMS-151:desc:0: When rate limiting causes partial outages, agents invent different customer-facing explanations, some of which over-promise timelines or imply a full platform down. We need approved language.
strings.issue:NMS-151:desc:1: Publish a short internal guide with: what customers may observe (429s, delayed webhooks), safe wording for status updates, what not to say (no root-cause speculation), and links to the status page component for API rate limits. Done when Support Comms and SRE both approve and the guide is linked from the incident bridge checklist.
strings.issue:NMS-152:title: Create fixtures for escalation timer tests across timezones
strings.issue:NMS-152:desc:0: Escalation timer unit tests assume the process timezone is UTC, so failures appear for engineers in US/Pacific and Asia/Seoul. We need fixtures that pin zones explicitly.
strings.issue:NMS-152:desc:1: Add shared fixtures covering timer start/stop across UTC, America/New_York, and Asia/Tokyo, including a DST spring-forward boundary for New York. Done when the escalation timer suite passes with TZ set to each of those values in CI matrix jobs.
strings.issue:NMS-153:title: Add a dashboard tile for open billing disputes older than 7 days
strings.issue:NMS-153:desc:0: Billing leads lack a at-a-glance signal for disputes stuck open longer than a week. They currently filter the disputes table manually.
strings.issue:NMS-153:desc:1: Add a manager dashboard tile "Open billing disputes > 7 days" showing count and a drill-down list sorted by age. Data source: disputes where status IN (open, needs_info) and opened_at < now() - interval 7 days. Acceptance: tile matches a manual SQL count on staging for tenant tnt_dash_demo, refreshes at most every 5 minutes, and respects the viewer's workspace scope.
strings.issue:NMS-154:title: Billing questions experience
strings.issue:NMS-154:desc:0: Improve how customers ask and resolve billing questions: portal invoices, proration copy, form attachments, refund macros, and routing into the Billing Questions queue. Cuts repeat tickets that bounce between support and finance.
strings.issue:NMS-155:title: Triage queue modernization
strings.issue:NMS-155:desc:0: Modernize triage so SLA-first sorting, bulk labels, workspace isolation, and merge aftermaths behave predictably. First-response metrics depend on this queue more than any other support surface.
strings.issue:NMS-156:title: Escalation and on-call reliability
strings.issue:NMS-156:desc:0: Fix escalation timers, on-call auto-assign, handoffs, and chat transcript export so high-severity tickets stay owned. Night-shift EU coverage gaps and timer resets are the recurring pain this epic targets.
strings.issue:NMS-157:title: Support portal fundamentals
strings.issue:NMS-157:desc:0: Stabilize the customer-facing support portal: ticket status sync, SSO on the support subdomain, macros, reopen windows, agent draft autosave, and outage language. Portal trust is the entry point for every other support epic.

strings.comment:NMA-10:jira:10100:0: This started after the pagination change landed last week.
strings.comment:NMA-10:jira:10101:0: Moving to review, the fix is behind a flag.
strings.comment:NMA-100:jira:10185:0: Not reproducible with a single member — needs at least three.
strings.comment:NMA-100:jira:10186:0: Deferring: the affected code path is being replaced next quarter.
strings.comment:NMA-101:jira:10187:0: Reopening — the same trace showed up again this morning.
strings.comment:NMA-101:jira:10188:0: Workaround for now: reload the page after switching workspaces.
strings.comment:NMA-102:jira:10189:0: Root cause is the cache key missing the workspace id.
strings.comment:NMA-103:jira:10190:0: Not reproducible with a single member — needs at least three.
strings.comment:NMA-104:jira:10415:0: Confirmed on staging with a fixture that forces 25 rows to the same updatedAt; page size 10 dropped 5 rows.
strings.comment:NMA-104:jira:10416:0: Composite cursor implemented; codec version bumped to v2 so old cursors still decode for one release.
strings.comment:NMA-104:jira:10417:0: Contract tests added for duplicate sort values. Verified full walk returns 40/40. Shipping.
strings.comment:NMA-105:jira:10418:0: Reproduced with a subscriber that always returns 503; after attempt 8 the DLQ depth rose and zero delivery_failed events left the gateway.
strings.comment:NMA-105:jira:10419:0: Hooked emitTerminalFailure into the DLQ admission path and added an idempotency key so double admission cannot double-notify.
strings.comment:NMA-105:jira:10420:0: Load test with 500 doomed deliveries: 500 terminal events, no extras. Deployed to production.
strings.comment:NMA-106:jira:10421:0: ntp drift on api-node-3 was 220ms at incident time — matches the repro window.
strings.comment:NMA-106:jira:10422:0: Switched bucket indexing to Redis TIME-based IDs; local clocks no longer influence the window.
strings.comment:NMA-106:jira:10423:0: Chaos test injecting ±500ms skew no longer refills early. Closed.
strings.comment:NMA-107:jira:10424:0: Need to confirm whether we patch 2.4.x or only document the upgrade — checking support volume.
strings.comment:NMA-108:jira:10425:0: Stack trace points at decodeFilter.Assignee in worker-common — matches nested null.
strings.comment:NMA-108:jira:10426:0: Changed nested optionals to pointer fields and added a fuzz fixture of null-heavy payloads.
strings.comment:NMA-108:jira:10427:0: No crashes in 12h soak on staging with the null fuzzer. Deployed.
strings.comment:NMA-109:jira:10428:0: Added a table-driven test of 12 invalid due date strings; all were 500 before the fix.
strings.comment:NMA-109:jira:10429:0: Mapped parse errors to FieldViolation{field: dueDate}. Contract tests assert 422.
strings.comment:NMA-109:jira:10430:0: Production error rate for this path dropped to zero after deploy. Closing.
strings.comment:NMA-110:jira:10431:0: Cache dump on a delivery pod still showed the old secret 18s after rotation API returned 200.
strings.comment:NMA-110:jira:10432:0: Trying explicit cache delete on rotation commit before considering dual-sign grace.
strings.comment:NMA-110:jira:10433:0: Delete path works in staging; writing the dual-sign option as a follow-up so clients can opt into overlap.
strings.comment:NMA-111:jira:10434:0: Compared edge vs origin header dumps on the same throttled token — Retry-After only on origin.
strings.comment:NMA-111:jira:10435:0: Edge template now emits Retry-After from the bucket reset timestamp.
strings.comment:NMA-111:jira:10436:0: SDK integration test against edge staging passes. Done.
strings.comment:NMA-112:jira:10437:0: Reproduced with a 300 KiB fixture body and a known test secret — server sig valid, SDK reports mismatch.
strings.comment:NMA-112:jira:10438:0: Bumping the buffer to 1 MiB and adding a clear error if Content-Length exceeds the cap.
strings.comment:NMA-113:jira:10439:0: Wrote a fixture batch of 10 issues across 2 projects; response listed 6 ids and HTTP 200.
strings.comment:NMA-113:jira:10440:0: Now reject mixed project keys with 400 when the bulk mode is atomic (default), and offer mode=best_effort with explicit per-item errors.
strings.comment:NMA-113:jira:10441:0: Contract tests cover both modes. Deployed; changelog notes the default atomic behavior.
strings.comment:NMA-114:jira:10442:0: Traced lease expiry at t=30s while export still on chunk 2 of 7.
strings.comment:NMA-114:jira:10443:0: Moved heartbeats to a background ticker and added lease extend every 10k rows inside the encode loop.
strings.comment:NMA-114:jira:10444:0: 2M-row export on staging held a single lease for 4m12s with no redelivery. Shipped.
strings.comment:NMA-115:jira:10445:0: Confirmed debounce classification: assignee field is in the deferred set in indexer config.

strings.page:131074:title: Release Notes
strings.page:131074:body:1: Internal notes aligned with board fix versions 2026.6.0 through 2026.9.0 and platform releases v2.3–v2.5. Customer-facing copy lives in the PROD space under Release Comms.
strings.page:131074:body:2: Always list reopened bugs and regression-labeled issues that rode the train so support can cross-check customer reports against the real fix set.
strings.page:131074:body:3: Child pages cover 2026.7.0, 2026.8.0, and platform v2.5; keep them updated until the train ships, then freeze.
strings.page:131090:title: Product Home
strings.page:131090:body:1: Specs, briefs, and release communications for the Nimbus dashboard suite. Engineering implementation tracks live in NMB for the board, NMA for the API and SDK, and NMS for the support portal.
strings.page:131090:body:2: Start from roadmap themes on this home tree, open a product brief for exploration, then promote to a full feature spec once capacity is committed.
strings.page:131090:body:3: Keep language free of real customer names; use example.com links only when linking out of Confluence.
strings.page:131106:title: Component Map — Platform API
strings.page:131106:body:1: REST API, Webhooks, Workers, SDK, and Rate Limiting share auth middleware and request IDs. Failures often span two components—treat the map as a dependency graph, not a folder list.
strings.page:131106:body:3: Webhook DLQ exhaustion without a final failure event: NMA-105.
strings.page:131106:body:4: Rate limiter windows resetting early under clock skew: NMA-106.
strings.page:131106:body:6: Idempotency keys on create endpoints: NMA-142.
strings.page:131106:body:7: Ship NMA-142 before we advertise at-most-once client retries in public SDK docs. OpenTelemetry around webhook fan-out is NMA-170; PII redaction for worker debug logs is NMA-172.
strings.page:131122:title: Component Map — Board Product
strings.page:131122:body:1: The board product splits into Auth, Billing, Dashboard, Editor, and Notifications. Cross-component bugs usually hide in shared chip or toast primitives.
strings.page:131122:body:3: Filter chips resetting after a workspace switch: NMB-104.
strings.page:131122:body:4: Chart legend overlap at 1280px viewports: NMB-105.
strings.page:131122:body:5: Notification toasts stacking under the sticky editor toolbar: NMB-108.
strings.page:131122:body:6: Editor autosave writing the previous revision every third save: NMB-109.
strings.page:131122:body:7: Workspace switcher showing a stale plan tier until full reload: NMB-110.
strings.page:131122:body:8: Dashboard layout work for 2026.8.0 must not regress heatmap rendering under forced colors; that path is NMB-121.
strings.page:131122:body:9: Collaborative protocol documentation for SDK consumers is NMB-174; initial-paint performance budgets for mid-tier laptops are NMB-181.
strings.page:131138:title: QA — Dashboard Regression Suite
strings.page:131138:body:1: Dashboard charts, heatmaps, refresh behavior, and filter chips before each board train.
strings.page:131138:body:3: Filter chips survive workspace switch — NMB-104
strings.page:131138:body:6: Refresh button single network flight in Firefox — NMB-129
strings.page:131138:body:7: Widget drag-and-drop on the last row — NMB-142
strings.page:131138:body:9: No new failures with performance or accessibility labels. Attach screenshots for any visual delta above one pixel on legend layout.
strings.page:131154:title: Feature Spec — Workspace Switcher
strings.page:131154:body:1: 워크스페이스를 전환한 뒤 요금제 티어가 전체 페이지 새로고침 전까지 오래된 값으로 보입니다. 추적 이슈는 NMB-110이며 고객이 빌링 문의를 올리는 주요 원인 중 하나입니다.
strings.page:131154:body:4: 필터 칩이 기본값으로 초기화되지 않아야 한다 — NMB-104
strings.page:131154:body:5: 관리자 SSO 강제 초대 설정 NMB-152와 충돌하지 않을 것
strings.page:131154:body:7: 대시보드 범례 겹침 이슈 NMB-105와 같은 2026.8.0 릴리스 열차에서 시각 회귀가 없어야 하며, 전환 후 2초 이내에 티어 표시가 일치해야 한다.
strings.page:131154:body:8: QA는 두 개 이상의 워크스페이스를 가진 데모 계정으로 수동 스모크를 남긴다.
strings.page:491694:title: Nimbus Engineering Home
strings.page:491694:body:1: This space holds runbooks, postmortems, ADRs, and QA playbooks for the platform team.
strings.page:491694:body:2: Start from Architecture or Runbooks when you need the current source of truth.
strings.page:491714:title: Product Briefs
strings.page:491714:body:1: Lightweight problem framing before full specs. Use briefs for exploration, prioritization, and cross-team alignment when the solution shape is still open.
strings.page:491714:body:2: Promote a brief to a Feature Spec once engineering capacity is committed for the quarter. Briefs that stall more than two cycles should be archived with a one-line reason.
strings.page:491714:body:3: Link support themes from Customer Research when the problem originated in CSAT or ticket volume.
strings.page:491730:title: Engineering Onboarding Guide
strings.page:491730:body:1: Welcome to the Nimbus engineering team. This document is your first-week checklist. Your mentor is Alex Kim.
strings.page:491730:body:3: Set up your local environment (see Local Development Setup)
strings.page:491730:body:4: Reproduce filter chip issue NMB-104 on the demo board
strings.page:491730:body:5: Practice attaching a screenshot for the dashboard legend overlap bug NMB-105
strings.page:491730:body:6: Run one test related to the editor autosave regression NMB-109
strings.page:491730:body:8: NMB is the board product, NMA is the platform API/SDK, and NMS is the support portal. Bugs with many reopens—for example notification digest duplication NMB-139—deserve a wider fix scope.
strings.page:491748:title: Internal Notes — Platform v2.5
strings.page:491748:body:1: SDK retry middleware ignoring 503 Retry-After: NMA-123
strings.page:491748:body:2: createIssue dropping multi-select custom fields: NMA-118
strings.page:491748:body:3: Field metadata caching deleted custom fields for a full TTL: NMA-125
strings.page:491748:body:5: NMA-118 and NMA-125 both reopened—pair SDK and REST owners for the same patch window. Cursor pagination skipping duplicate sort values (NMA-104) remains open for v2.5.1.
strings.page:491766:title: Postmortem — SDK Retry and Custom Fields
strings.page:491766:body:1: Two related platform regressions reopened together. SDK retry middleware did not honor 503 Retry-After delays (NMA-123). createIssue dropped multi-select custom field values (NMA-118). The field metadata endpoint also cached deleted custom fields for a full TTL (NMA-125).
strings.page:491766:body:3: Integrators retried too aggressively during a partial outage; some custom field writes silently dropped.
strings.page:491766:body:6: Invalidate field metadata on delete within sixty seconds
strings.page:491766:body:7: Contract tests for multi-select create payloads
strings.page:491782:title: Postmortem — Notification Digest Duplicates
strings.page:491782:body:1: Notification digests duplicated events near the midnight boundary (NMB-139). Preference toggles also reverted if the user navigated away within two seconds (NMB-120).
strings.page:491782:body:3: Roughly three percent of workspaces spanning UTC midnight saw double emails. Reopen count on the digest bug was two.
strings.page:491782:body:5: Digest window bucketing used local timezone while dedupe keys used UTC days.
strings.page:491782:body:7: Unify digest keys on UTC day boundaries
strings.page:491782:body:8: Add regression tests labeled regression and customer-reported
strings.page:491782:body:9: Audit toast stacking under the editor toolbar covered by NMB-108
strings.page:491798:title: QA — Auth and SSO Matrix
strings.page:491798:body:19: Run the full matrix after any IdP certificate change. Pair with the SSO certificate rotation runbook.
strings.page:491814:title: Release Notes 2026.8.0 (Customer)
strings.page:491814:body:1: Dashboard readability on mid-size screens and several billing invoice improvements for enterprise tax modes.
strings.page:491814:body:2: Chart legends no longer overlap axis labels at common laptop widths — NMB-105
strings.page:491814:body:3: Invoice PDF blank second page resolved — NMB-106
strings.page:491814:body:4: Upcoming invoice amount on billing settings — NMB-150
strings.page:491814:body:5: Reverse-charge tax line items no longer double-count — NMB-126
strings.page:491814:body:6: Enterprise admins should re-download a sample PDF after upgrade. Visual changes to heatmaps under forced colors are intentional accessibility fixes.
strings.page:491830:title: Roadmap Review 2026-07-10
strings.page:491830:body:1: Prioritize notification reliability over new dashboard widgets until last-row drag-and-drop (NMB-142) and midnight digest duplication (NMB-139) are closed.
strings.page:491830:body:2: Platform idempotency keys (NMA-142) land before any new bulk mutation endpoints.
strings.page:491830:body:4: Compact board density remains behind a flag until card label overflow (NMB-140) is fixed.
strings.page:491848:title: Research — Notification Fatigue
strings.page:491848:body:1: Users request snooze controls and better digests. Evidence aligns with snooze work in NMB-153, feed filters in NMB-162, and the midnight duplication fix in NMB-139.
strings.page:491848:body:2: Preference UI trust is low after toggles revert on quick navigation (NMB-120). Several CSAT comments mentioned turning notifications off entirely rather than tuning them.
strings.page:524466:title: Nimbus Product Home
strings.page:524466:body:1: This space collects product briefs, feature specs, meeting notes, and release comms.
strings.page:524466:body:2: Use Product Briefs or Product Meetings for the latest decisions and roadmap context.
strings.page:524481:title: Postmortems
strings.page:524481:body:1: Blameless write-ups for production incidents. Prefer issues with reopen history as signals of incomplete fixes rather than one-off flukes.
strings.page:524481:body:2: Security and privacy incidents such as cross-tenant display escalate as Sev-1 regardless of customer count. Timeline, root cause, and action items are required; owner assignment is not optional.
strings.page:524481:body:3: Publish within five business days of mitigation. Link related runbooks when the fix changes on-call procedure.
strings.page:524497:title: Data Retention Policy
strings.page:524497:body:1: Workspace data is retained for the life of the subscription plus thirty days. Worker job history is partitioned for cold storage; do not invent ad-hoc retention flags in product code.
strings.page:524497:body:2: Support attachment virus scans that never complete for large files are tracked in NMS-120—unscanned blobs must not remain durable beyond twenty-four hours.
strings.page:524497:body:4: Debug logs must follow the redaction policy work in NMA-172 before anyone enables verbose worker logging in production.
strings.page:524497:body:5: No credentials in SQLite mirrors or snapshots
strings.page:524497:body:6: No customer email in unstructured worker logs
strings.page:524497:body:7: Webhook payload samples redacted in support tools

strings.page:557057:title: Architecture
strings.page:557057:body:1: Nimbus is a multi-tenant SaaS dashboard product. The board product (NMB), platform API (NMA), and support portal (NMS) share a single identity plane and workspace model.
strings.page:557057:body:2: Use the child pages below for system context, component maps, retention policy, and observability standards before opening a new design doc. Prefer linking open Jira keys when a diagram or decision constrains active work.
strings.page:557057:body:3: Board UI: Auth, Billing, Dashboard, Editor, Notifications
strings.page:557057:body:4: Platform: REST API, Webhooks, Workers, SDK, Rate Limiting
strings.page:557075:title: ADRs
strings.page:557075:body:1: ADRs capture durable engineering choices. Each child page follows Status, Context, Decision, and Consequences so future readers can re-evaluate the trade-off without replaying chat history.
strings.page:557075:body:2: Link Jira keys when a decision unblocks or constrains active work. Review open ADRs during onboarding and before large refactors that touch workspace scope, webhooks, or the editor protocol.
strings.page:557075:body:3: Start from the shared template at
strings.page:557075:body:5: and keep status accurate (Proposed / Accepted / Superseded).
strings.page:557093:title: Feature Specs
strings.page:557093:body:1: Detailed specs for shipping features. Each child page should list open Jira keys, acceptance criteria, and out-of-scope notes so engineering and QA share one source of truth.
strings.page:557093:body:2: Korean specs sit alongside English ones to support bilingual search demos and dual-language stakeholders. Prefer short sections over long prose walls.
strings.page:557093:body:3: When a spec ships, leave a comment with the release train version and close or re-home open issue links.
strings.page:557111:title: Observability Standards
strings.page:557111:body:1: Webhook fan-out traces under NMA-170 use the shared trace context. Worker crashes when payloads contain nested null optional fields—see NMA-108—must include job type attributes on the span.
strings.page:557111:body:3: PII redaction from NMA-172 is mandatory before enabling debug on production workers. Prefer structured fields over free-text concatenation.
strings.page:557111:body:6: . Alert rules live next to the service, not only in this wiki.
strings.page:557129:title: ADR-001 Workspace Scoping Middleware
strings.page:557129:body:3: Multi-tenant request contexts were applied inconsistently across board and API routes. That contributed to stale plan tier displays after workspace switches (NMB-110) and seat count mismatches on accounts with more than a thousand seats (NMS-68).
strings.page:557129:body:5: All authenticated handlers receive a typed workspace scope. Middleware rejects cross-tenant resource IDs before handlers run.
strings.page:557129:body:7: Board and API share the same scope library
strings.page:557129:body:8: SDK tests must send workspace headers on every call
strings.page:557145:title: ADR-002 Webhook Secret Dual Validation
strings.page:557145:body:3: Rotating webhook secrets caused verification failures during the grace window. Dual-validation support is NMA-146; related delivery failures that exhaust the DLQ without a final event are NMA-105.
strings.page:557145:body:5: During rotation, accept either the previous or current secret for thirty minutes and emit dual-validation metrics.
strings.page:557145:body:7: The runbook for replaying failed deliveries (NMA-162) must document which secret was active at event time. Grace window length matches the SSO certificate guidance used by support.
strings.page:589825:title: Runbooks
strings.page:589825:body:1: On-call procedures for Nimbus production. Steps must be copy-pasteable; use placeholders instead of installation-specific hostnames or account ids.
strings.page:589825:body:2: Pager rotation and escalation contacts are maintained by Alex Kim in the ops calendar. Child pages cover webhook DLQ replay, rate-limit storms, SSO certificate rotation, worker lease exhaustion, billing PDF triage, and Sev-1 cross-tenant display response.
strings.page:589825:body:3: After any runbook change, dry-run the steps on staging and note the date in a page comment.
strings.page:589841:title: Customer Research
strings.page:589841:body:1: Anonymized themes from support tickets and CSAT. No real customer names, domains, or contact details—use example.com only if you need an outbound link.
strings.page:589841:body:2: Themes feed product briefs and feature specs. Link related Jira keys when defects already exist so engineering can estimate against known work.
strings.page:589841:body:3: Refresh each research note at least quarterly; stale themes mislead prioritization.
strings.page:589857:title: Runbook — Webhook DLQ Replay
strings.page:589857:body:1: Webhook delivery retries exhaust the DLQ without surfacing a final failure event—that symptom is NMA-105. The longer-term runbook and tooling work is tracked as NMA-162.
strings.page:589857:body:3: Confirm subscription id and time range in the ops dashboard
strings.page:589857:body:4: List delivery attempts via the public endpoint once NMA-132 ships; until then use admin mirrors
strings.page:589857:body:5: Replay with the secret that was active at event time (see ADR-002 dual validation)
strings.page:589857:body:6: Watch fan-out traces when OpenTelemetry work in NMA-170 is enabled
strings.page:589857:body:8: Stop replay jobs if error rate exceeds five percent for ten minutes. Page platform if the DLQ refill rate does not drop after one full cycle.

strings.page:622625:title: ADR-004 Rate Limit Header Semantics
strings.page:622625:body:3: Edge 429 responses omit Retry-After today (NMA-111). SDK retry middleware already mishandles 503 Retry-After delay values (NMA-123). Rate limiter windows reset early under clock skew between API nodes (NMA-106).
strings.page:622625:body:5: Standardize X-RateLimit-* plus Retry-After on every 429. Document tiers and header semantics for public consumers under NMA-151.
strings.page:622625:body:7: Support needs stable customer-facing language for rate-limit related outages (NMS-151) once headers stop changing week to week.

strings.page:655395:title: Runbook — Sev-1 Cross-Tenant Display

strings.page:655411:title: Runbook — Worker Lease Exhaustion
strings.page:655411:body:1: Long-running exports hold a lease until the heartbeat expires (NMA-114). Concurrency semaphores leak slots after a panicked handler (NMA-124). Nested null optional fields in job payloads crash workers (NMA-108).
strings.page:655411:body:3: Drain the export queue and pause new multi-minute jobs
strings.page:655411:body:4: Restart worker pods one availability zone at a time
strings.page:655411:body:5: Capture payloads that contain nested nulls for the NMA-108 fix set
strings.page:655411:body:6: Progress checkpoints for multi-minute exports are tracked as NMA-135—treat that as a follow-up, not a hot patch during the incident.
